Description:
At Gene4All, we believe that access to genomics and genome engineering knowledge should know no borders. Our mission is to democratize genomics by empowering scientists, institutions, and communities in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) through training, capacity building, innovation, and global collaboration.

We work to bridge the gap between cutting-edge biotechnology and regions where talent is abundant but resources are limited. Through hands-on workshops, tailored educational programs, strategic advisory services, and innovation support, we enable local researchers to lead impactful projects in public health, agriculture, and biotechnology.

Our approach is built on three pillars:

    Training & Education – Delivering practical, high-quality learning experiences in genomics and genome engineering.

    Capacity Building – Providing tools, mentorship, and access to global expertise so local talent can thrive.

    Collaboration – Connecting LMIC researchers with international partners, fostering equitable and sustainable scientific exchange.

By combining scientific excellence with social impact, Gene4All serves as a catalyst for innovation, helping to unlock the potential of genomics for health, food security, and economic development worldwide.

Name: Project BIO-Boost
Description: The overall objectives of the BIOBoost project are to increase the latent potential of the participating innovation agencies, to learn from leading innovator regions, and to cement this knowledge and experience in the organisations, building and expanding networks, expanding the cooperation and enlarging the participation of more diverse innovation stakeholders and territories to existing successful initiatives in the bioeconomy, including agri-food, forestry, bio-based chemicals, materials and products, and bioenergy. The partnership will implement a range of activities via peer-to-peer learning, including study visits and staff exchanges, to develop closer relationships within the partnership, and with the wider regional innovation ecosystems, as well as to learn improved innovation support measures. These will be cemented via operational work to build and develop innovation ecosystems and SMEs via hackathons and challenges (160 organisations involved), by providing direct SME support on innovation management (24 crossborder KAM cases), and helping widening country SMEs towards financing of innovation projects (50+ cases). Over 450 SMEs will be engaged with during the implementation of the project, which will include active cooperation with 20 other innovation ecosystems. BIOBoost connects 7 homogenous EU regions in terms of similarities of RIS3 and S3 Platform synergies related to bioeconomy and digitalisation. The multidisciplinary partnership has been strategically selected, to work in an inclusive and interactive bottom-up process, to discover potential new activities, and identify new opportunities that emerge from this interaction. Despite the homogeneity in terms of regional smart specialisation, the consortium consists of partners with a wide variety of complementary skills and experience, covering a wide geographical area and with considerable economic, social and environmental differences.

Name: 60Nd
Description:
NeoMag is the first magneto-mechanical platform that simulates pathological processes in biological systems for more predictive drug testing in a non-invasive, contact-free and portable by design way.

Unlike traditional systems that rely on vacuum or direct mechanical stretching to deform membranes, our technology utilizes magnetic fields and smart polymers (MAPs). This allows for the application of precise forces on cells and 3D tissues (organoids) without disturbing the culture media or damaging samples, ensuring a level of biological integrity that was previously impossible to maintain during stimulation.

We uniquely solve the lack of predictability in drug development by integrating mechanical realism with ease of use. Our "plug-and-play" platform is compatible with advanced microscopy, enabling researchers to observe in real-time how cells respond to mechanical pathologies, such as cancer or traumatic brain injury. Powered by our AI control engine, scientists can program complex and dynamic deformation patterns, accelerating the discovery of therapeutic targets and drastically reducing the reliance on animal testing.

Name: Water2REturn
Description:
Water2REturn is an Innovation Action co-funded by the European Commission under its Horizon 2020 (H2020) programme. It is coordinated by BIOAZUL company (Malaga, Spain) and is focused on the recovery and recycling of nutrients from slaughterhouses wastewater in the framework of a Circular Economy model. Nutrients recovered are turned into value added products for the agro-chemical industry and, consequently, for the agricultural sector.
Water2REturn proposes a viable, cross-sectoral and integrated full-scale demonstration process by using a novel combination of biochemical and physical technologies and processes in cascade, aiming also a positive balance in terms of energy footprint –biological aeration systems, membrane technologies, anaerobic processes for bio-methane production and algal technologies, all combined in a zero-waste- emission system, with an integrated monitoring control tool that improves the nutrient flows data quality – . An environmental, economic, social and risk assessment of the technology performance and the products obtained will be also performed.
Water2REturn brings together 15 multidisciplinary actors from 8 different European countries – 9 SMEs, 2 European associations, 1 research centre and 3 universities – to implement an integrated solution for slaughterhouse wastewater treatment, as well as for the recovery of nutrients with high market value in the
agricultural sector.

Name: AcroBioPLAST - Interreg POCTEFA Project
Description: A pesar de los recientes esfuerzos en el reciclaje de plástico, una gran cantidad de plástico aún no se recupera y continúa convirtiéndose en residuo. Como resultado, los esfuerzos para desarrollar materiales biodegradables y reciclables han aumentado en los últimos años. Bioplásticos como el ácido poliláctico y la policaprolactona han surgido como posibles sustitutos de los plásticos derivados de combustibles fósiles, ya que son materiales biodegradables. Sin embargo, sus aplicaciones biomédicas están limitadas debido a un tiempo de degradación muy lento (3 o 4 años) y propiedades mecánicas débiles. Estos bioplásticos están compuestos por largas cadenas poliméricas que dificultan la difusión de agua y enzimas necesarias para su biodegradación. El objetivo de AcroBioPLAST es superar estas limitaciones mediante la preparación de nuevos copoliésteres e inclusión de aditivos basados en azúcares nanoestructurados. La presencia de una fase polisacárida dentro de la matriz plástica aumentará la tasa de degradación, mejorará las propiedades mecánicas y proporcionará capacidad antimicrobiana simultáneamente. AcroBioPLAST es un proyecto multidisciplinario que combina investigación científica (química, física y microbiología) y aplicación industrial, abarcando desde la producción de bioplásticos en escala piloto, a la creación de productos sanitarios fabricados de acuerdo con la regulación MDR 2017/745. Al final del proyecto se planea desarrollar un prototipo con el cual se pueda iniciar la validación preclínica (TRL 4). De esta manera, el sector de bioplásticos, altamente representado en el área POCTEFA, podrá desarrollar materiales innovadores con propiedades avanzadas. El sector médico también se beneficiará al utilizar estos bioplásticos para reemplazar los biomateriales empleados actualmente. La cooperación transfronteriza permitirá abordar el problema a una escala regional relevante y beneficiarse de una sinergia de habilidades y conocimientos.

Name: EcoBD Lab] Creative Ecosystems and BioDesign. Research Group
Description:
In a world marked by environmental and social challenges, creativity and biodesign emerge as key tools to formulate sustainable and innovative solutions. The Creative Ecosystems and Biodesign research group: EcoBD Lab, is attached to the Faculty of Design and Creative Technologies of the Creative Campus of the European University of Madrid. This interdisciplinary laboratory explores the intersections between biological design, sustainability and technological innovation, with a particular focus on art, science and technology. EcoBD Lab operates under the premise that creativity is an essential catalyst for meeting the challenges posed by the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 
Its vision is oriented towards generating positive impact in fields such as design, fashion, art and architecture, anticipating future scenarios and solving current problems through interdisciplinary research. Its lines of action are organized around three fundamental axes:
1. Development of biomaterials and sustainable products. The creation of innovative and emerging materials with sustainable and recyclable properties is prioritized, promoting integration of advanced technologies and eco-efficient design. These initiatives cover fields such as art, design and architecture, using tools such as manufacturing
digital to encourage conscious and sustainable practices.
2. Design of bioinspired and biomimetic environments and spaces. Inspired by nature, this approach applies biomimetic principles to develop products and systems that emulate the efficient and sustainable solutions of natural ecosystems, integrating aesthetics and functionality.
3. Ecological art and bioremediation. Bioremediation practices that combine art, science and technology are explored, restoring ecosystems and promoting a dialogue between creativity and scientific protocols.

• Develop patient-friendly biodegradable gels that are as least invasive as possible.
• Establishing our technology for dental and orthopaedic implants.

We want to provide a revolutionary and patient-friendly alternative to traditional antibiotic therapies, which often exacerbate the growing problem of antimicrobial resistance.

Description:

Sus productos, destacados por su eficacia y ya en el mercado son:  el Aero-S3DP, un  sistema de análisis de la calidad del aire, el AMR-S3DP el sistema que detecta e identifica la presencia de bacterias es espacios cerrados (mide partículas, temperatura, humedad entre otros parámetros de la calidad del aire, siendo idónea para espacios de alto riesgo) y el Hydro-S3DP, un sistema de análisis de la calidad del agua que en la actualidad se encuentra en la selección de instalaciones para la verificación de su efectividad.
Diseñado para cumplir la normativa de espacios sensibles, el AMR-S3DP está concebido para un uso en quirófanos y zonas infecciosas, dispone de una tecnología muy desarrollada con el fin de alcanzar un alto grado de eficiencia. Por este motivo, el AMR- S3DP ha encontrado cabida en el sector agrícola, donde una pronta detección de la presencia de bacteria permite actuar antes de que estas afecten a la producción. 
El sistema del AMR-S3DP permite la consulta, análisis y transmisión de datos, así como la ejecución de algoritmos y comparación de patrones que sirven para identificar en tiempo real la calidad del aire utilizando la inteligencia artificial y un sistema de machine learning.

Name: Bluetools
Description:

It will do so, by integrating different fields to develop cutting-edge tools that support fast, efficient, and sustainable exploration and exploitation of microbiomes, avoiding the drawbacks of conventional biodiscovery practices. 

This general objective comprises 6 goals:

1. Reduce the environmental impact of bioprospecting by investigating alternative and sustainable sources of microbiomes.

2. Establish innovative cultivation and enrichment procedures using minimal volumes to maximise the potential of marine microbiomes for environmental and industrial applications.

3. Develop beyond the state-of-the-art bioinformatic tools to overcome the current limitations of metagenomic data processing pipelines for genome-resolved, high-quality data, portability, and interoperability.

4. Use a fast and versatile discovery approach to discover microbes, proteins, and genes for several applications, among others pharma and medicine, materials, environmental applications, and agriculture.

5. Create the road for the generated solution products to reach the market through specialized training, exploitation, dissemination, communication, and engagement with key societal actors.

6. Ensure the cost and environmental performance of BLUETOOLS's microbiome-based solutions are competitive through the integrated use of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA).

Name: XRB
Description:

Other important objectives of the XRB are to foster the exchange of knowledge between public sector researchers and private enterprise, to take an active and critical role as regards raising public awareness of biotechnology, to promote collaboration with industry, and to encourage the setting up of new biotech firms.


Rather than being concentrated in a single physical location the XRB is formed by over 400 researchers who belong to the following institutions::

University of Barcelona (UB) 
Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB) 
Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) 
Institute of Food and Agricultural Research and Technology (IRTA) 
Centre for Research in Agricultural Genomics (CRAG)

Within the XRB these researchers are organized into seven units.

The current scientific research of the XRB is being conducted within the framework of the 2010-2011 funding agreement, signed with the Catalan Ministry of Innovation, Universities and Enterprise.

The Director is Anicet R. Blanch of the University of Barcelona. The management body is the Bosch i Gimpera Foundation (FBiG).

Flavii Therapeutics S.L. is a biotechnology company focused on developing epigenetic therapies for central nervous system (CNS) disorders. We are committed to transforming lives by offering new hope to patients and families affected by these conditions, which currently lack curative treatment options.

Our lead program, FLAV-27, is a first-in-class small molecule that acts as a potent and selective inhibitor of G9a, a key epigenetic regulator involved in brain function. FLAV-27 is a SAM-competitive inhibitor, offering high specificity with minimal off-target effects. It demonstrates excellent blood-brain barrier penetration and favorable pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) properties.
Preclinical studies have shown that FLAV-27 provides neuroprotection and improves neuroinflammation and neuronal plasticity in models of Alzheimer’s disease, Huntington’s disease, and neurodevelopmental disorders. It enhances cognition, memory, motor function, and social behaviors. Toxicology studies confirm a strong safety profile, with no adverse effects observed even at doses 200 times higher than the therapeutic dose.

Flavii is advancing FLAV-27 towards clinical trials, aiming to deliver a novel, disease-modifying treatment that addresses the root causes of CNS disorders and offers real hope to patients.

La prevalencia de la alergia a alimentos se ha incrementado de manera continua durante las últimas décadas en los países desarrollados, donde se considera un grave problema de salud pública que afecta a un 3-6% de los niños y tiene un tremendo y negativo impacto en la calidad de vida. Name: "Bridging RNA Biology and Therapy" Symposium

Official page of the upcoming symposium, «Bridging RNA Biology and Therapy: Exploring the Frontiers of Advanced Medicine,» scheduled to take place from October 9th to 11th at the Center for Applied Medical Research (CIMA) in Pamplona, Spain.

RNA research stands out as one of the most promising domains in advanced medicine. It has emerged with unprecedented vigor, offering great promise as an area of exciting discoveries and transformative results. With steadfast commitment to translating research into tangible patient benefits over the past 20 years, CIMA takes particular interest and pride in supporting investigations in RNA medicine and in hosting this symposium.

The symposium will feature several sessions on interconnected key areas of advanced RNA research, led by some of the most prominent international speakers. They will cover the latest findings related to the complexity of the human transcriptome and the associated mechanisms of gene regulation underlying disease. Moreover, the possibility of using RNA molecules as drugs to treat or prevent diseases has opened up a broad range of potential medical applications. The symposium will showcase innovative strategies for applying RNA discoveries, including methods to facilitate their implementation through molecule delivery.

Sessions will offer opportunities for oral presentations selected from abstracts by both young and established researchers, as well as poster presentations.

Follow this page to stay tune about this meeting where we will collectively explore the frontiers of advanced medicine through the lens of RNA biology.

Description:

Our work is centered on the development of advanced statistical methodologies to refine and individualize reference intervals (RIs) for in vitro diagnostic (IVD) assays. Traditional population-based RIs often fail to capture inter-individual variability; our models incorporate demographic, clinical, and biological covariates to generate personalized, context-specific intervals that improve diagnostic sensitivity and specificity.
To support this framework, we are building a universal data lake that integrates large-scale, heterogeneous clinical and laboratory datasets. This standardized repository enables the validation of statistical models across diverse cohorts, facilitates biomarker discovery, and strengthens the translational bridge between research and clinical implementation.
Our mission is to transform reference interval estimation into a dynamic, data-driven process—anchored in reproducible research, statistical rigor, and global interoperability—ultimately advancing the accuracy and clinical utility of laboratory medicine.

Description:

We aim to improve diagnosis, classification, and treatment monitoring through the detection of Minimal Residual Disease (MRD). By conducting comparative studies between normal hematopoietic cells and their malignant counterparts, we seek to unravel the oncogenic events and the role of the immune system in controlling or promoting neoplastic expansion.

Technological Innovation and Translation
A high priority is the translation of biological data into clinical diagnostics. Our core activities include:

Advanced Immunophenotyping: Enhancing flow cytometry panels for higher sensitivity and specificity.

Automation & Standardization: Developing high-throughput systems for automated data analysis to overcome the complexity and subjectivity of manual interpretation in clinical settings.

Immune Monitoring: Implementing multiparametric approaches to monitor immune responses following antitumor immunotherapy.

Primary Research Lines
Systemic Mastocytosis: Phenotypic and molecular characterization to clarify the role of immune interactions in disease progression and identify molecular patterns associated with severity.

Chronic Lymphoid Neoplasms: Investigating factors involved in the transformation of pre-leukemic conditions into malignant diseases, identifying mechanisms of clonal evolution, and characterizing the normal T, B, and NK-cell counterparts.

Correlating somatic mutations with signaling pathways via proteogenomics.

Analyzing TCR sequences and HLA immunopeptidomes.

It is a Distributed ICTS made up of 4 nodes: Advanced Translational Imaging Infrastructure (TRIMA) in Madrid, Molecular and Functional Imaging Platform of the CIC biomaGUNE in San Sebastian (Gipuzkoa), Bioimaging Centre of the Complutense University of Madrid (BioImaC) and PREBI-GIBI230 Infrastructure (Imaging La Fe) of the University and Polytechnic Hospital La Fe in Valencia.

Biomedical imaging modalities available at ReDIB include: Positron Emission Tomography (PET, preclinical and clinical), Single Photon Emission Tomography (SPECT, preclinical), Computed Axial Tomography (CT, preclinical and clinical), Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI, preclinical and clinical) and optical imaging and cell analysis (preclinical), as well as preclinical (PET/CT, SPECT/CT) and clinical (PET/MRI) hybrid imaging, complemented by laboratories for the preparation of contrast agents and infrastructures that allow their in vitro evaluation.

ReDIB offers its facilities through open access calls, which can be requested by researchers from public and private, national and international entities. The granting of these access requests is carried out through regulated procedures of merit and free competition, as regulated by the ReDIB Access Protocol. 

The ReDIB website offers information on the services it provides and the characteristics of its essential facilities.

En ella, el clínico puede registrar al paciente, contextualizar los resultados y generar el informe final.

Nuestra propuesta diferencial se basa en combinar análisis avanzado de microbiota con una base de datos propia de referencia, construida a partir de voluntarios sanos y orientada a generar comparaciones más relevantes por territorio, hábitos y contexto poblacional. Esto permite que cada paciente no se compare únicamente con rangos genéricos, sino con perfiles de referencia más cercanos a su realidad biológica y ambiental.

Incorporamos AIMA Care, un sistema de IA que ayuda al profesional a interpretar los resultados, priorizar biomarcadores y convertir los datos ómicos en recomendaciones clínicas accionables. Name: tellmeGen
Description:
At tellmeGen, we believe that knowing your DNA should not be a privilege, but the foundation for taking control of your health and your future.
As a leading international biotechnology and health company, we have developed the most comprehensive predictive and preventive genetic tests on the market. Our mission is transformative: to democratise genetic information.

What we do: Through a saliva sample, we analyse thousands of genetic variants to provide critical information in four key areas:
Health and Prevention: Predisposition to hundreds of conditions and diseases.
Pharmacogenetics: Personalised compatibility and response to medications.
Traits and Wellness: Information on metabolism, nutrition, athletic performance, and physical traits.
Ancestry: Connecting individuals with their geographical origins and global history.

Medical support: We bridge the gap between data and people. Our team of geneticists offers expert advice to ensure a safe and responsible interpretation.

We are redefining the future of personalised medicine.

Name: DIVERSA Technologies
Description:
Our drug delivery technology based on lipidic nanoemulsions allows for safe and physiological intracellular delivery of complex macromolecules (peptides, proteins and nucleic acids) and small hydrophobic molecules. The platform has broad and fresh IP protection and is fully scalable and regulatory compliant. 

At DIVERSA, we want to bridge the gap between molecules and patients, between drug discovery and clinical application. We want to create new opportunities to improve patients' quality of life.

Despite the discovery of many new targets and therapeutic molecules in labs around the world, less than 3% of them will make it to clinical stages. Most of these new molecules are discarded in the early stages of research, mostly because they cannot access the interior of the cell, where 3 out of 4 new molecules have their targets. We want change that. We want to spearhead the therapeutic revolution.

Name: Nuage Therapeutics
Description: Nuage Therapeutics is a biotech company focused on developing small molecule inhibitors of oncogenic transcription factors. The company has a particular focus on drugging cell lineage-specific transcription factors that are known cancer dependency genes. Built on a deep understanding of transcriptional regulation and the biophysics of intrinsically-disordered proteins (IDPs), Nuage has developed technologies that enable the ‘capture’ of IDPs in higher-order, self-assembled states that present binding pockets that render these proteins amenable to small molecule drug discovery. This represents a game-changing advance that has led to the identification of functional inhibitors of multiple transcription factors that were previously considered undruggable.

Name: Onalabs Inno-Hub
Description:
Point-of-Care (POC) technologies, designed to provide rapid clinical diagnosis at, or near the site of patient care, has the potential to sense changes in well-known biomarkers used already to monitor patients with chronic cardiac and respiratory diseases. However, they need to be measured in blood, which limit their use only in medical institutions. 
Our non-invasive products based on wearable formats will empower the patients and their families to measure relevant biomarkers anytime and anywhere, allowing them to detect and monitor early stages of possible clinical deterioration, which could prelude in earlier (self-)management strategies, resulting in shorter hospital stays and prevention of unnecessary treatments. Our social impact will be a priority.
Our challenge is addressed to patients of all ages, from neonates with congenital heart disease and bronchiolitis’, to the elderly with chronic heart failure due to myocardial infarction or chronic lung diseases and asthma. Our product offers continuous, non-invasive monitoring that have a positive health impact to the health deterioration. We will support active aging and improve the self-management of health.

Name: Mimark Diagnostics
Description:
At MiMark, we believe that diagnosing a disease should never add more suffering to patients. That’s why we’ve developed a revolutionary diagnostic approach that uses gynecological fluids to diagnose gynecological diseases efficiently and accurately. Our mission is clear: to make gynecological diagnosis simpler, safer, and more human – for patients, clinicians, and healthcare systems alike.
 
*Disease is complicated. Diagnosis shouldn't be.*
 
For decades, women's health has been underestimated in research and diagnostics.Existing tests for gynecological diseases are often invasive, painful, costly, and sometimes inconclusive.
 
At MiMark, we are changing that reality by developing protein-based diagnostics that extract clinical insights from a simple, minimally invasive gynecological sample. Our work is grounded in science, designed with empathy, and built to transform healthcare globally.
 
*Our Platform: GyLDa - Science that flows naturally.*
 
In MiMark, we have standardized the handling of gynecological fluid samples to ensure reproducibility, stability, and seamless implementation in clinical laboratories. We have developed a curated pipeline that translates protein biomarker candidates from high-throughput Mass Spectrometry Data into Proprietary Key Reagents development and validated Immunoassays.
 
Our pipeline includes GyLDEC, for endometrial cancer diagnosis, and GyLDENDO, for endometriosis diagnosis.
 
Discover more in our Website (see the link below).

Name: Biomaterials, Biomechanics and Tissue Engineering Research Group (BBT-UPC)
Description:

BBT belongs to the María de Maeztu Unit of Excellence - Center for Research in Multiscale Science and Engineering (CCEM), the Institute for Research and Innovation in Health (IRIS) and the UPC Innovation and Technology Center (CIT-UPC), both of them members of TECNIO.
The group is also part of the Centro de Investigación Biomédica en Red de Bioingeniería, Biomateriales y Nanomedicina (CIBER-BBN) at Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII) and of Institut de Recerca Sant Joan de Déu (IRSJD).

BBT's Scientific Director, Prof. Maria Pau Ginebra, is an ERC Advanced Grant awardee (2022-2027), National Research Award Leonardo Torres Quevedo, in Engineering and Architecture by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities (2025), ICREA Acadèmia Prize by the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya) to excellence in research in four consecutive editions (2008, 2013, 2018 and 2023), and an Associated Researcher to the de Institut for Bioengineering of catalonia (IBEC).

Name: Laminar Pharma
Description:
Laminar Pharma is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, rational design and development of a new generation of medicines that act through the innovative therapeutic strategy known as “Membrane-Lipid Therapy” (MLT). Laminar Pharma arose in 2006 as an academic spin-off to commercially develop new scientific know-how and applications generated by leading scientists at the University of the Balearic Islands (UIB) in Mallorca, Spain, headed by Prof. Pablo V. Escriba.

Laminar Pharma aims to develop next-generation medicines, nutraceutical and cosmetic products based on the novel Membrane-Lipid Therapy (MLT) strategy, which targets membrane lipids and/or the structures they form, rather than directly targeting specific cellular proteins. MLT-based drugs specifically interact with and modulate the activity of key signal-transduction peripheral proteins involved in the pathogeny of serious diseases like cancer, CNS, inflammatory or metabolic diseases.

Innovative MLT-based drugs will soon become reference treatments worldwide for serious diseases with important medical needs unmet, such as glioblastoma and other aggressive cancer malignancies, as well as neuro-degenerative, metabolic, cardiovascular or inflammatory diseases. These  novel drugs will provide a safe and efficacious therapeutic alternative that will bring dramatic improvements in the clinical outcome and in the quality of life for an important number of patients with these pathologies.

We are creating cutting edge supercomputer-based patient modeling and simulation solutions, deployed in the cloud, that help MedTech and Pharma companies optimize their products and offer new evidence to clinicians to personalize treatments.

To learn more, visit us at http://elem.bio or email us at contact@elem.bio.

Name: Decco Iberica Post Cosecha S.A.U.
Description:
Decco Ibérica Post Cosecha S.A.U. es la sede en España de Decco Postharvest, división de postcosecha de la multinacional india UPL.
Decco Ibérica ofrece productos y servicios para la postcosecha de frutas.
Decco ofrece una amplia gama de productos destinados a:

Limpieza, desinfección y lavado de frutas, ceras, recubrimientos, fungicidas, productos para desinfección de cámaras de almacenamiento y contenedores, termógrafos para el control de la temperatura, bolsas MAP, etc.
Consulte nuestros productos en la web: www.deccoiberica.es

Name: AllGenetics
Description: Since founding AllGenetics in 2011, we have become one of the most highly regarded laboratories when it comes to outsourcing genomics-related projects. We excel for two reasons: first, our expertise in high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics; second, our excellent rapport with our clients. This is why research teams and private companies have recommended us as their trusted genomics partner year after year.

Name: GoodGut
Description:
GoodGut is a biotechnology company focused on researching and developing analysis systems and therapeutic products to improve the diagnosis and treatment of digestive diseases based on intestinal microbiota.

We aim to provide technological tools that will help to obtain a faster, more reliable and lower cost medical diagnosis than existing methods, alongside therapies to improve the quality of life of patients with compromised digestive health.

The company was created in 2014 as a spin-off of the University of Girona (UdG) and the Institute of Biomedical Research of Girona Dr. Josep Trueta (IdIBGi). Our facilities can be found in the Scientific and Technologic Park of the UdG, an innovation hub housing over 140 companies, research groups and institutions.

Name: IUL SA
Description:
Since 1987, IUL has been dedicated to innovating high-quality, reliable equipment that empowers laboratories around the world. With nearly four decades of experience, we specialize in two main areas of expertise: microbiology laboratory solutions and lateral flow readers.

In microbiology, our mission is to simplify and automate microbiological testing, improving accuracy, efficiency, and traceability for laboratories of all sizes. We continuously integrate the latest technologies — including artificial intelligence (AI) — to advance applications such as automated colony counting, enhancing precision and throughput in laboratory workflows.

For our lateral flow readers, our mission is to develop devices that provide unmatched sensitivity and high accuracy for both human diagnostics (IVD) and veterinary applications. These systems combine advanced optical technology with intelligent image processing to deliver rapid, reliable, and quantitative results, supporting effective decision-making in diagnostic testing.

Today, IUL operates from three headquarters worldwide, allowing us to be even closer to our customers — providing faster support, deeper collaboration, and tailored solutions that meet regional needs.

Driven by science, guided by precision, and inspired by progress, IUL remains a trusted partner for laboratories and diagnostic professionals seeking excellence in microbiological analysis and lateral flow testing.

Name: Vellsam Materias Bioactivas
Description:
VELLSAM MATERIAS BIOACTIVAS, S.L. is a company dedicated to the manufacture and commercialization of biostimulants and plant nutrients. Nowadays, the activity is dedicated to the manufacture, preparation and distribution of root and leaf fertilizers based on biotechnological applications and respect for the environment.

It is a company whose philosophy is based on offering complete and comprehensive services to 21st century agriculture.

We are approaching a new era, new concepts based on biotechnology and above all respect for the environment.

These are our challenges, and for this we have advanced manufacturing and research systems which are at our customers' service.

We offer integral consultancy to the client for the development of new agro-nutrients and products (R & D consultancy, product registration, .....). In our company we research and develop new phytonutrients suitable to the needs of our customers.

It is a company dedicated from the beginning to the formulation of active principles within the sector of the manufacture or production of phyto-nutrients of organic base, as biostimulants and vegetal nutrients that go from the application of microorganisms to the soil to the plant that on one hand release the nutrients that are blocked in the soil and on the other, synthesize another assimilable by the plant, to make them available at the time of stress, nutritious substances that can be incorporated into its structure or physiological processes directly (rooting, aid in flowering, curdling, maturation , retardants, etc.) in each of the different stages in their development, as well as in different species.

Name: Canvax
Description:
Since 2001, Canvax has been a trusted manufacturer and supplier of high-performance enzymes, kits, buffers, and reagents for the Life Science industry. 

Our flexible, scalable, and cost-efficient manufacturing structure, combined with uncompromising quality standards, allows us to deliver exceptional performance, reliable supply, and outstanding customer service.

From small-scale R&D batches to large-scale BULK production, Canvax provides fully customizable solutions that empower researchers and biopharma companies to accelerate discovery and development.

Our state-of-the-art facilities in Spain (3,400 m2) are purpose-built for the production of enzymes, buffers, and bioreagents at commercial scale, operating under internationally recognized certifications:
 ISO 9001:2015
 ISO 13485:2016 for Ancillary Reagents
 cGMP compliant, continuously improving in line with ICH Q7

With a team of 60+ professionals (35% PhDs) covering the entire biopharmaceutical value chain, from research to clinical stages, we ensure a smooth, risk-free transition from pilot to full-scale production. The result: consistent quality, reduced time to market, and total confidence in your manufacturing partner.

Canvax, your reliable partner in enzyme and reagent manufacturing excellence.

Name: Plant Health Care Europe
Description:
Plant Health Care es un proveedor líder de productos biológicos científicamente probados para la industria agrícola. La compañía ofrece bioestimulantes para mejorar la eficiencia y la calidad de los nutrientes y reducir el estrés abiótico de los cultivos especializados como los cítricos, la uva de mesa y la mayoría de las frutas y verduras clave, así como los principales cultivos de campo como el arroz, la caña de azúcar y las patatas.

Nuestra innovadora línea de bioestimulantes protegidos por patente con un retorno comprobado de la inversión proporciona beneficios para nuestros clientes y capitaliza las tendencias a largo plazo hacia sistemas naturales y soluciones de bioestimulantes para promover la mejora de la salud de las plantas.

Plant Health Care tiene alcance global a través de subsidiarias operativas y acuerdos de suministro con los principales socios de la industria.

Plant Health Care is a leading provider of scientifically proven biological products for the agricultural industry. The Company offers biostimulants to improve nutrient efficiency, quality and to reduce abiotic stress  of specialty crops such as Citrus, Table Grape and most key fruit and vegetables as well as major field crops such as Rice, Sugar Cane and Potatoes.

Our innovative line of patent protected biostimulants with proven return on investment provides benefits for our customers and capitalizes upon long-term trends towards natural systems and biostimulant solutions to promote plant health enhancement.

Plant Health Care has global reach through operating subsidiaries and supply agreements with major industry partners.

Name: SPINREACT
Description: At Spinreact we are committed to facilitating access to clinical analysis in the places it is really needed. Every day we strive to offer solutions adapted to the needs of our distributors and the laboratories around the world.

Name: Cultek
Description:
Cultek, S.L.U. was formed in Madrid, Spain in 1976. The company's core business is the distribution and servicing of biochemicals and instrumentation for the Life Science market. Cultek currently belongs to the Dutscher Group.

Cultek's strengths lay on the knowledge of science and technology,  its service capacity and the relationship with its customers. Cultek serves its clients as source of information and training in innovative technologies as they first come into the market.

We market laboratory instruments, biochemicals and disposables for research and diagnostics of humans, veterinary and plants based on the following bio-molecules of extraordinary complexity: DNA, RNA, Proteins, Cells, Bacteria, Virus, Prions, Antibodies, etc.   Our offer includes consulting, application development,  one-stop-shop source of product and services, training, installations, after-sales support, etc
Location: San Fernando de Henares, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: Gate2Brain
Description:
Gate2Brain is a biotech company focused on the development of therapeutics that efficiently cross biological barriers such as the blood-brain barrier. Gate2Brain pursues its goals using a radically innovative peptide-based patented technology platform.  

G2B-002, Gate2Brain flagship product and proof of concept of the technology, offers a new therapeutic approach with improved biopharmaceutical properties and potent activity against rare paediatric cancers.

Name: Cytognos S.L.
Description:
Cytognos is a Biotech company based in Salamanca with over 20 years of experience at successfully designing, developing, manufacturing and commercializing innovative flow cytometry products for in vitro diagnostics (IVD) and life science research use only (RUO). Cytognos ́ growth strategy has been based on bringing to the market exclusive technologies transferred by research centres and universities, these innovative products have allowed Cytognos to become a reference point, providing world-class products developed to address gaps within the current multicolour flow cytometry workflow.

Cytognos collaborates actively with the EuroFlowTM consortium implementing and bringing onto the market the Next Generation FlowTM approach which provides high sensitive flow cytometry tests and standardized protocols for the diagnosis, classification and follow-up of haematological malignancies, Minimal Residual Disease detection and Primary Immunodeficiencies.
Location: Santa Marta de Tormes, Castilla and Leon, Spain

Name: Green Universe Agriculture
Description:
Green Universe es una compañía de biotecnología agrícola que desarrolla productos bioactivos que optimizan la nutrición, la resistencia y la vitalidad vegetal para lograr cultivos más fuertes, sostenibles y, sobre todo, más rentables.

Combinamos conocimiento científico avanzado en fisiología vegetal, microbiología y biotecnología con sólida experiencia en campo para crear bioactivos con impacto real, consistente y medible en el rendimiento agrícola.

Desde España, y con más de 17 años de innovación y presencia en más de 50 países —con filiales en España, Perú, Chile, México, Reino Unido y Estados Unidos— operamos a escala global combinando ciencia, tecnología y ejecución en campo.

Formamos parte de Green Universe Agrogroup, junto a empresas pioneras como Legume Technology y Pheromon, impulsando la I+D aplicada y estrategias integradas de cultivo a nivel global.

─────────────────────────────

Green Universe is an agricultural biotechnology company that develops bioactive products designed to optimize plant nutrition, enhance resilience, and improve crop vitality—delivering stronger, more sustainable, and more profitable yields.

We combine advanced scientific knowledge in plant physiology, microbiology, and biotechnology with extensive field experience to create bioactives with real, consistent, and measurable impact on crop performance.

Headquartered in Spain, and with over 17 years of innovation and presence in more than 50 countries—including subsidiaries in Spain, Peru, Chile, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and the United States—we operate globally, integrating science, technology, and field execution.

We are part of Green Universe Agrogroup, alongside pioneering companies such as Legume Technology and Pheromon, driving applied R&D and the development of integrated crop strategies worldwide.

Name: Biobizz Worldwide SL
Description:
Our philosophy is very simple: to make organic agriculture reach as many people as possible to minimize the impact we leave on the world we live in.

Since we started making organic products in 1992, we have strived to create sustainable agriculture, encourage self-sufficiency, and highlight the importance of using natural products and methods to obtain everything we need.

Since then Biobizz has not stopped growing. Today we are present in 70 different countries, but the feeling is still that of belonging to a family, because all team members know each other and work together to ensure that Biobizz continues to be a leading company in the sector.

We believe that it is time for agriculture to leave the laboratory and take roots where it belongs: Earth. Every time you use Biobizz you can be sure that no harmful element will end up contaminating nearby waters or decimating the wildlife in your area while enjoying your healthy plants and abundant harvest.

We live organic farming
Biobizz not only creates 100% organic products for organic farming. We also encourage good practices when cultivating using our products in our own greenhouse.

Currently, the Biobizz headquarters are located in Bilbao. In this location, most of the administrative departments are located, such as Finance, Marketing, or Logistics, as well as the main production plant for our products. In addition, we have offices in Barcelona, France, the UK, and the United States.

These facilities, together with our Sales Department, allow us to have a presence in 64 different countries around the world. Biobizz products can be found in almost every country in Europe, North and South America, and other countries, such as South Africa or Australia.

Name: Banco Español de Algas
Description:
The Spanish Bank of Algae (BEA) is an infrastructure of the Universidad of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria managed by the Canarian Science and Technology Park Foundation (FCPCT). Its basic objectives are the isolation, characterization, conservation, supply and development of cultivation techniques and applications of microalgae and cyanobacteria from a scientific-technological point of view.

The BEA is a member of the European Culture Collections’ Organisation (ECCO), of the World Federation for Culture Collections (WFCC) and is included in the World Data Centre for Microorganisms (WFCC-MIRCEN), being accredited before the Government of Spain as the international authority for the deposit of microorganisms, in accordance with the provisions established in the Budapest Treaty.

Strains of microalgae from tropical and subtropical regions are conserved in the BEA, particularly from the Macaronesian region. This collection of strains (> 1700 clonal strains) offers great potential for the development of industrial applications, allowing companies, scientific groups, and institutions around the world access to unique genetic resources, hardly explored, for their application in biotechnological processes. 

It also offers services to companies, research institutions and technological development centres, to facilitate the implementation of initiatives and projects essentially related to industry and research on microalgae and cyanobacteria.

Name: Innomy
Description: Innomy develops global solutions for the food industry such as meat analogues or functional flours, always using sustainable biotechnological processes based on fungal mycelia and revaluing by-products from various industries as raw materials.

Name: PLANT SCIENCE & BIOTECH by BS
Description: Beyond Seeds is not just a good slogan, it's a new way of understanding research and innovation, focusing them on something simple and at the same time magical as the seed.

Name: Biotechvana
Description:
Delivering services and software products for processing and analysis of biological data since 2006 working with renowned hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, universities, among others. We combine our services according to the needs of your project or study. How can we help you?

- We have a suite of applications for omic data analysis and knowledge Discovery, linkable to remote servers to run bioinformatic pipelines in the cloud.
- Customized LIMS
- Data analyses services for Genomes, Transcriptomes, Metagenomes, Metatranscriptomes:

   - Microbial Omics Analyses
- Programming Services (Biological Databases, tailor-made software and pipelines)
- “All-In-One” Integral services for bioinformatics infrastructures.
- Contribution in national and international projects

Name: Biocontrol Technologies
Description:
Biocontrol Technologies is a Bio tech Company (spin-off from Barcelona University) created in 2004 and dedicated to develop biopesticides (microbes) to control crop diseases with effectiveness of conventional chemical pesticides, but safety to human health and environment and according the most restrictive Regulation (Europe and USA). The first product developed by Biocontrol Technologies to-date is based on Trichoderma asperellum, strain T34 (biopesticide): T34 Biocontrol. 

Biocontrol Technologies aims to be a reference enterprise in the development of microbials for plant health. The company is marketing the product by selecting key distributors in the areas of interest. These distributors are compromised in the development of biological control and/or integrated pest and disease management.

The team of Biocontrol Technologies has the technical capacity to isolate micro-organisms based biopesticides, perform studies for the development of such products and advice for the submission of the technical dossier near the EU Regulatory authorities for products of other Biotech companies interested in the development of microbial pesticides. The team of Biocontrol Technologies also has the technical capacity to train staff of distributors and growers on biological /integrated control of plant diseases.

Name: Anaxomics Biotech S.L.
Description:
Anaxomics is AI biotech company that use cutting-edge technologies based on Systems Biology to overcome challenges in drug discovery and development process. We’re specialized in In Silico Clinical Trials, which offer a highly efficient way to optimize clinical trials. 

Our proprietary technology, Therapeutic Performance Mapping Systems Technology (TPMS), enables to build mathematical models that elucidate the mechanisms of action of drugs and identify biomarkers to monitor in the trials. With TPMS, we also provide early profiling of safety issues and off-target effects, helping to optimize clinical trials and speed up the drug development process.

Our team of experts is dedicated to advancing scientific knowledge and bringing innovative solutions to pharmaceutical and biotech companies and researchers worldwide. We are delighted to offer our services in both fee-for-service and collaborative arrangements, including initiatives such as H2020 and RIS3CAT, to meet the unique needs of our clients and partners while delivering high-quality results.

We have a proven track record of success, with numerous successful projects and collaborations under our belt. Our flexible working arrangements and exceptional service ensure that we achieve success in all of our projects.

Our services include:
-	In Silico Clinical Trials (ISCT)
-	Elucidating mechanisms of action
-      Real World Evidence (RWE) studies
-	Identify biomarkers  for diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment
-	Identify new indication of existing drugs: Repurposing
-	Identify combinatorial therapies
-	Identify therapeutic targets and off-targets 
-	Early profiling of safety issues and off-target effects

At Anaxomics Biotech, we are committed to improving the drug discovery and development process, paving the way for more effective and efficient treatments for patients worldwide.

Name: SunRock Biopharma, S.L
Description:
SunRock is a biopharmaceutical company, developing sophisticated therapeutic antibodies under innovative formats antibodies to treat incurable cancer. SunRock, working under an open innovation system, aims to develop the different programs from early discovery to the completion of phase I clinical trials.
SunRock has developed an extensive portfolio of bispecific molecules targeting CCR9 and HER3 raising high expectation among the key players of the industry.

Description: Genbioma is a biotechnology company that transforms microbiome science into clinically validated postbiotics that enhance cardiometabolic health by restoring microbiota balance, naturally activating metabolism and the GLP‐1 pathway

Name: Biobest España
Description: Biobest es uno de los líderes a nivel mundial en polinización natural y en control biológico de plagas y enfermedades.

Name: Biotech Tricopharming Research
Description:
At Biotech Tricopharming Research, we specialize in optimizing the production of valuable therapeutic compounds in Medicinal and Aromatic Plants. 

Our expertise lies in biotechnology and biopharmaceutical agriculture, enhancing the therapeutic potential of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants through the development of specific and cutting-edge biostimulants. This allows us to produce optimized and standardized plant ingredients with applications across various sectors, including Veterinary (under the Artennua brand), Agriculture and Cosmetics.

Additionally, we offer customized R&D services for third parties, such as tailored biostimulant design, agronomic characterization, and molecular mode-of-action analysis.

-----

En Biotech Tricopharming Research, nos especializamos en optimizar la producción de compuestos terapéuticos de alto valor en Plantas Medicinales y Aromáticas.

Nuestra experiencia se basa en la biotecnología y la agricultura biofarmacéutica, potenciando el valor terapéutico de las Plantas Medicinales y Aromáticas mediante el desarrollo de bioestimulantes específicos y de última generación. Esto nos permite producir ingredientes vegetales optimizados y estandarizados con aplicaciones en diversos sectores, incluyendo el veterinario (bajo la marca Artennua), agrícola y cosmético.

Además, ofrecemos servicios de I+D personalizados para terceros, como el diseño de bioestimulantes a medida, la caracterización agronómica y el análisis del modo de acción a nivel molecular.

To fulfill our vision, we work with our customers by becoming key technology partners, boosting their discovery workflow with the most innovative solutions. Description:
The Institute of Research, Development, and Innovation in Healthcare Biotechnology in Elche (Instituto de Investigación, Desarrollo e Innovación en Biotecnología Sanitaria de Elche, IDiBE), belongs to the Miguel Hernández University (UMH). Name: Fecundis Lab
Description:
Fecundis Lab is a reproductive biotechnology company focused on assisted reproduction. We are the team behind HyperSperm, the first sperm capacitation kit developed to address a critical and long-overlooked biological step in IVF workflows.

Our work combines reproductive biology, translational science, and product development to turn cutting-edge science into practical innovation for fertility care. By focusing on sperm capacitation, we are advancing an area with major clinical relevance but limited product innovation to date.

We are committed to developing science-driven solutions that improve the consistency, efficiency, and overall performance of ART.

Name: Iberania
Description: Iberania is a European full-service medical device CRO based in Spain, providing customized clinical and regulatory services to start-up and established companies.

Name: Biohope
Description:
Biohope es una empresa biomédica en fase comercial centrada en la investigación y desarrollo de herramientas IVD DE MEDICINA DE PRECISIÓN, para mejorar los resultados clínicos en pacientes con afecciones inflamatorias crónicas y enfermedades autoinmunes.

Biohope ha desarrollado un kit de diagnóstico in vitro llamado Immunobiogram para facilitar un tratamiento farmacológico personalizado para pacientes con enfermedades inflamatorias crónicas.  
El primer producto, para pacientes con trasplante renal, ha mostrado resultados positivos en nuestros estudios clínicos. El inmunobiograma es un ensayo funcional celular de ayuda para prescripción de los inmunosupresores. Proporciona, el nivel de sensibilidad de las células inmunitarias del paciente a los fármacos inmunosupresores con el fin de facilitar un tratamiento personalizado para mejorar los resultados clínicos.

Aborda una enorme necesidad médica insatisfecha (de +1 millón de pacientes en el mundo, el 50% rechazará el órgano en menos de 10 años).

BIOHOPE ha lanzado al mercado su primer producto, tras haber estudiado con éxito el Inmunobiograma para trasplante renal en estudios clínicos nacionales e internacionales con los principales hospitales de Europa y EEUU. 
BIOHOPE ha cumplido con todos los hitos planificados hasta ahora, lo que confirma que es una empresa confiable y prometedora.

Hechos relevantes:
Software único y base de datos de la respuesta de los linfocitos T del paciente.
Patentes publicadas y marcas registradas en los principales mercados.
Marcado CE para el primer producto en trasplante renal.
Licencia de fabricación.

El objetivo de BIOHOPE es apoyar a los médicos proporcionándoles herramientas para optimizar y personalizar los tratamientos (medicina de precisión) y así mejorar la respuesta y la calidad de vida de los pacientes. Para lograr este objetivo, se está llevando a cabo una sólida cartera de enfermedades autoinmunes.
Location: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: Loop Dx
Description:
Loop Diagnostics (LoopDx) is a IVD company developing rapid immune-response diagnostics to support earlier and better decisions in suspected sepsis and bloodstream infection.

Our lead product, SeptiLoop, is a CE IVDR Class C near-patient test that measures the functional response of the patient's innate immune system. SeptiLoop helps clinicians identify early immune dysfunction linked to severe bacterial bloodstream infection, well before traditional blood culture results are available. This allows faster triage, targeted antibiotics, and better use of critical care resources.

SeptiLoop is designed for emergency and critical care settings and is positioned as one of the first new-generation IVD tests in Europe cleared under the IVDR Class C framework. It brings functional immunology to the bedside in a format that is simple, fast, and actionable.

LoopDx is now preparing commercial rollout in the United Kingdom and the European Union, together with health economic validation and clinical utility studies in high-risk patients.

Name: Centro Andaluz de Biología del Desarrollo

Name: AELIX Therapeutics

Name: CIDAF Centro Tecnológico
Description:
El Centro Tecnológico CIDAF es un centro multidisciplinar especializado en ingredientes bioactivos para agricultura, alimentación, ganadería y cosmética..

El Centro Tecnológico CIDAF, se constituyó en 2012 con la misión generar nuevos conocimientos científicos en ingredientes bioactivos transferibles al sector productivo generando valor añadido y de esta forma contribuir al desarrollo económico, social y sostenibilidad de nuestro sector.

Name: Camm Solutions
Description:
Camm Solutions is a greentech company that has developed the fully sustainable and commercially viable material solution CAMM to combat global (micro)plastic pollution and eliminate waste. 

CAMM represents a breakthrough in material science, copying nature's own processes. It's engineered to function like plastic, yet when it's time to decompose, it does so with care for the environment, integrating back into the ecosystem without leaving harmful traces. When laminated or extruded onto paper, CAMM rivals the properties of multilayer packaging. In the recycling process, the CAMM layer washes away, enabling complete paper fiber recovery – a stark contrast to typical packaging that retains microplastics.

Camm Solutions was initiated by Christoph Bertsch, a serial entrepreneur with over 25 years of experience, who was driven to solve the microplastic problem for one of his other companies. The CAMM idea resulted out of that quest. Supported by a diverse international group of shareholders representing the full CAMM value chain from raw material to recycling, close to €50M were invested to develop patented CAMM formulations and launch sustainable game changers like CAMM airpillows and stretchfilm. Today, CAMM embodies a practical vision of sustainability, proving that innovative ideas can create real-world eco-friendly solutions.

Name: InnoUp
Description:
InnoUp is a clinical-stage nanotechnology company focused on developing safer and more effective treatments for Food Allergies, Oncology, and Vaccines.

We have developed a new drug encapsulation platform currently being tested in different clinical and pre-clinical programs.

INP20 - Oral Peanut Allergy Vaccine: Phase I
INP12 - Low-toxicity Paclitaxel oral chemotherapy for Breast Cancer: Phase I
INP30 - Oral Vaccine Infectious Diseases: pre-clinical

Our encapsulation platform is based on biocompatible nanoparticles that allow all types of payloads (drugs, proteins, RNA, and DNA). These nanoparticles have been engineered to increase bio-adhesion capacity to the mucosa, which translates into a need for lower and safer drug doses to achieve a therapeutic effect. Therefore, drugs encapsulated using our platform become more effective and safer. The technology is protected worldwide, including USA and Europe, until 2035.

Our short-term business strategy includes starting operations in the US beginning 2022 with the opening of an affiliate in Boston, MA. From there, we will manage the movement to the next phases of our clinical programs (Phase II) in the US. We are already working with the FDA for the pre-IND meeting preparation. We plan to increase our value in the mid-term by building a clinical-stage multi-asset pipeline with expected significant efficacy and safety milestones by 2025.

Besides, we plan to build our GMP manufacturing facility to control our manufacturing process fully. We expect it to be fully operative by 2025.

We are actively working on raising money to cover the following steps and, we are open to considering all types of investment. In parallel, we are also actively seeking licensing partners interested in our products.

Name: CONNECTA Therapeutics
Description:
CONNECTA Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company leveraging its small-molecule neuroplasticity modulation platform to address unmet medical needs in Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders with a focus on pediatric neurodevelopmental conditions. Neuroplasticity is the ability of the nervous system to adapt its activity in response to intrinsic or extrinsic stimuli by reorganizing its structure, functions, and connections, and is impaired in the vast majority of these disorders.

The Company’s lead program, CTH120, is a first-in-class disease-modifying modulator for Fragile X Syndrome (FXS), a rare and currently untreatable neurodevelopmental disorder that strongly impairs cognition and behavior. CTH120 is a small novel molecule that targets the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB), a key mediator in brain development and function. Unlike existing symptomatic treatments, CTH120 aims to restore the underlying neuronal architecture. Supported by robust preclinical data and Phase I clinical results (NCT06480968), CONNECTA is advancing CTH120 through a Phase II clinical trial in adults with FXS. In parallel, and with additional support from the FRAXCURE project (co-funded by the European Union), the company is preparing to expand development into pediatric populations.

CONNECTA’s scalable neuroplasticity modulation platform has already yielded additional promising compounds that have shown potential in treating multiple CNS disorders. Preclinical models have demonstrated efficacy for FXS and Rett Syndrome, with the potential to address other high-value indications such as Down’s syndrome, DiGeorge syndrome, autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and neuropathic pain.

Description:
La idea de SECALFLOR nació en 1994 en Rheinsberg, al norte de Berlín. El uso de agua, nutrientes y pesticidas puede reducirse considerablemente gracias a las propiedades únicas y naturales de los paneles de SECALFLOR, que abren oportunidades para diferentes sectores e industrias.

Desde hace 20 años, los paneles de SECALFLOR han demostrado su eficacia en todo el mundo bajo las más diversas condiciones ambientales. Ante el que quizá sea el mayor reto de nuestro tiempo, el cambio climático con sus extremos meteorológicos y sus periodos de sequía, SECALFLOR asegura la continuidad de paisajes verdes y florecientes y cosechas más abundantes.

SECALFLOR sigue investigando y desarrollando su producto para optimizar los mecanismos de acción y encontrar nuevos ámbitos de aplicación. Para ello, hacemos especial hincapié en aportar los conocimientos técnicos de los últimos 20 años a todos los proyectos que hemos desarrollado en Alemania y en otros países del mundo.

Description:
VLPBIO IS A PIONEER BIOTECHNOLOGY COMPANY FOCUSED ON RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT OF CHIMERIC VIRUS LIKE PARTICLES (VLPS) AS VACCINES FOR HUMAN HEALTH.

Vaccines have historically been among the first “wonder drugs” to radically transform human health and longevity. Many infectious diseases, once the greatest threat to public health and the leading cause of death, have been reduced or even eradicated due to advances in vaccine development, improved sanitation and antibiotics.

Despite the significant progress made in the vaccine industry to date, two challenges remain: to produce vaccines against unmet or emerging targets, and to produce improved vaccines that are more effective than currently available products. VLPbio has developed proprietary technologies that address both of these challenges.

VLPbio focuses on virus-like particle (VLP) vaccines that mimic viruses but lack the ability to reproduce or cause infectious complications. VLP-based vaccines have had a tremendous impact on both human health and the industry itself, as evidenced by medical and commercial success in the human papillomavirus and Hepatitis B fields. VLPbio core technologies are contributing to the development of vaccine products.

Name: Cancer Genomics Lab - VHIO
Description:
The Cancer Genomics Group at the Vall d’Hebron Institute of Oncology (VHIO) operates as a central Core Facility, providing state-of-the-art genomic technologies for clinical and translational cancer research.

Our laboratory is equipped with Illumina NGS platforms (MiSeq, NextSeq and NovaSeq 6000) and Bio-Rad ddPCR systems, enabling comprehensive molecular profiling from both tissue and liquid biopsy samples.

We are pioneers in the development, validation and routine implementation of innovative NGS-based tests, including:

VHIO300, a 435-gene hybrid-capture panel

VHIO Epsilon Panel, an RNA-based assay for gene fusion detection and expression profiling

VHIO360, a cutting-edge liquid biopsy test

VHIO was also the first oncology research center in Europe to implement Guardant360 DX, enabling complete genomic profiling of solid tumors from a simple blood draw within seven days.

The VHIO Molecular Prescreening Program, co-led by Ana Vivancos together with Paolo Nuciforo, Elena Garralda and Rodrigo Dienstmann, is integrated into the Institutional Advanced Molecular Diagnostics Program (DIAMAV), supported by the FERO Foundation, and supports patient selection for early-phase clinical trials.

In 2024, we performed molecular profiling in over 2,300 patients, with more than 50% of analyses conducted using liquid biopsy, reflecting the growing clinical adoption of this approach. The Catalan Health Service (CatSalut) selected VHIO360 for first-line genomic profiling in metastatic lung cancer when tissue biopsy is not feasible.

Our panels VHIO300 and VHIO360 hold ISO 15189 flexible accreditation, and we are working toward accreditation of our personalized RNA sequencing panel VHIO Epsilon ɛ00.

Our research focuses on developing multiplexed genomic assays and on translational projects to identify mechanisms of resistance to targeted therapies and predictive biomarkers of response to immunotherapy, including the development of the pan-cancer predictive platform VIGex.

Name: TetraSOD
Description:
TetraSOD is a naturally occurring, activated marine microalgae (Tetraselmis chuii) that is proven to support the body’s key antioxidant and cellular defence pathways. Clinically studied, it helps reduce oxidative stress, modulate immune function, and protect cells from environmental and metabolic stressors.
This patent-protected ingredient is uniquely proven to enhance cellular health and fight age related health challenges by supporting cellular resilience, DNA integrity and healthy cellular signalling.
One of the most concentrated sources of SOD, a natural enzyme with antioxidant activity that serves as the body’s primary defence against oxidative stress, TetraSOD supports cellular renewal both immediately and over time. 
The result is a foundational ingredient for the next generation of longevity products that enables brands to credibly target longevity-led concepts, including beauty-from-within, women’s health and men’s health, using a single, science-backed solution.
Location: El Puerto de Santa María, Andalusia, Spain

Name: NEUROSTECH
Description:
NEUROSTECH is the world’s only biotechnology company that has designed, patented, tested, and developed human prototypes of fully implantable pumpless devices and smart catheters for the controlled intrathecal delivery of drugs.

We harness cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics to create innovative medical devices that deliver targeted, precise treatment exactly where it is needed. 

NEUROSTECH’s expertise in bioengineering supports a proprietary pipeline of medical devices, which are approaching clinical trials for neurological conditions. 

NEUROSTECH provides the safest solutions for novel treatment approaches in neurodegenerative diseases, addressing unmet medical needs for devastating conditions such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, ALS, and more
_________________
TECHNOLOGY

Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) naturally flows through the brain in rhythmic, pulsing waves, creating pressure differentials along the intrathecal space. 

NEUROSTECH is a global leader in leveraging CSF dynamics to develop innovative medical devices. By harnessing the natural flow of CSF, NEUROSTECH is pioneering the development of groundbreaking medical devices.  

 Our deep understanding of CSF dynamics allows us to design the next generation of intrathecal catheters that power pumpless devices.

NEUROSTECH also develops advanced subcutaneous reservoirs with cutting-edge architecture and user-friendly percutaneous ports. Through precise engineering of nanoporous membranes, we achieve full control over selective molecular permeability. 
_________________
PIPELINE

Fully implantable pumpless intrathecal devices enable two key modalities:
--> Clearance of toxic molecules from the CNS by intrathecal pseudo-delivery
--> Controlled intrathecal drug delivery for optimized distribution of therapies to the CNS  

Smart catheters for CSF management systems:
--> Stand-alone lumbar drainage
--> Systems combined with external filter devices for CSF filtration (extracorporeal liquorpheresis)

Name: STAb Therapeutics
Description: We are a biotech spin-off developing an innovative cell therapeutic platform to create next generation cell therapies in oncology. Our products - STAb Therapeutics - have been developed based on solid discoveries from our team of scientific founders at the Hospital 12 de Octubre in Madrid. We are harnessing cell engineering techniques to develop a new wave of cell therapies capable of efficiently redirecting the immune system with our STAb Therapeutics. Our technological approach involves a T cell redirecting strategy that combines principles of adoptive cell therapy and bispecific antibodies. This approach is based on the in vivo production of T cell-engagers (TCE) by engineered cells, which results in effective serum concentrations of TCE, expansion and persistence of adoptively transferred STAb – T cells, and polyclonal recruitment of both modified and unmodified bystander T cells present at the tumor microenvironment. We have validated the therapeutic potential of STAb -T cells  in B-cell and T cell hematological malignancies, and we aim to develop this platform to provide new therapeutic solutions to both hematological and solid tumors.

Name: BLUEPHAGE
Description:
BLUEPHAGE is a biotechnology company pioneering rapid viral indicators for microbiological water quality. Founded in 2016 as a spin-off from the University of Barcelona’s MARS group (Microbiology of Water Related to Health), we develop and commercialize next-generation coliphage detection kits aligned with ISO 10705, ISO 17994, and US EPA 1642/1643 standards.
Our patented technologies enable the fastest, most cost-effective, and easy-to-use detection of bacteriophages—the most reliable viral indicators for water safety. By targeting coliphages, our solutions act as early-warning tools against viral contamination in drinking water, wastewater, biosolids, food, and recreational water.

BLUEPHAGE’s products empower labs, water utilities, and health authorities to obtain accurate, regulatory-compliant results in under a single workday, without the need for complex sample concentration or extended incubation. Our portfolio includes quantitative and presence/absence kits, ready-to-use reagents, and tools compatible with automated or manual workflows.
Backed by 35+ years of research and a team of global experts in virology, microbiology, and environmental testing, we are transforming how the world monitors viral contamination—ensuring safe water for a better world.

Description:

Name: Inhibitec Anticuerpos, S.L.
Description:
Inhibitec-Anticuerpos S.L. was created in 2019 with the goal of introducing a new treatment for patients with psoriasis and Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA) based in the blockade of BAMBI (BMP and Activin Membrane-Bound Inhibitor).

We are a pioneering biotechnology startup that emerged as a spin off company from the prestigious University of Cantabria (group led by Dr. Jesus Merino, MD, PhD) and the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) (group led by Dr. Ramon Merino, MD, PhD).

Our journey has been marked by significant achievements, including:
- Discovery of BAMBI as a pivotal molecule governing the differentiation of CD4 lymphocytes.
- Development of B101.37, a murine monoclonal antibody (mAb) designed to selectively inhibit BAMBI, showing remarkable therapeutic potential for autoimmune /chronic inflammatory disease like psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA), and rheumatoid arthritis.
- Successful patenting of our groundbreaking technology, with extensions secured in both the United States and the European Union.
- Advancement of B101.37 mAb into a humanized form (hB101.37 mAb), ensuring its compatibility for use in patients.
- Rigorous validation of the therapeutic efficacy of hB101.37 mAb.

These milestones underscore Inhibitec’s commitment to advancing healthcare through innovative solutions at the intersection of biotechnology and medical research.

Name: RareBioTech S.L.
Description:
RareBioTech is a spin-off of the University of Salamanca (USAL) in the field of biotechnology applied to biomedicine located in the bioincubator Abioinnova (Salamanca, Spain). RareBioTech has been officially certified as a Startup by ENISA, in accordance with the Spanish Startup Law (Ley 28/2022).
This recognition validates our innovative and scalable business model in the biotech sector, as well as our commitment to developing proprietary high-capacity lentiviral vectors and 3D-bioprinted organoid platforms for genetics diseases. The ENISA Seal confirms that RareBioTech meets all key requirements: being a recently created company (spin-off of the University of Salamanca, 2025), having its headquarters in Spain, developing cutting-edge technology, not being listed on any stock market, and maintaining a turnover below €10M.
This certification is a crucial step forward, providing access to significant tax benefits and support mechanisms to accelerate our growth and international expansion.
Its scalable model and focus on biomedicine, especially genetics diseases, position it as a leader in precision biomedicine. Our portfolio is structured around four pillars:
• Production of high capacity lentiviruses (genes up to 11 kb) for biomedical research.
• Generation of stable cell lines.
• Development of organoids to model rare diseases.

Name: EpiSeedLink
Description:
The overreaching mission of EpiSeedLink is to foster a European network that empowers crop improvement through epigenetics by providing expertise, know-how, and creativity in high-end technologies to 11 early stage scientists and enabling them to translate scientific knowledge and skills into innovation. Through international, multidisciplinary, and inter-sectorial training in experimental and computational biology, EpiSeedLink will not only contribute to excellence in research but also timely address societal and agricultural needs. This original research program combines the unique know-how of academic experts with that of two seed companies to synergize research and knowledge transfer between a plant model (Arabidopsis) and a crop of enormous agroeconomic importance (oilseed rape). 
EpiSeedLink will exploit the epigenetic regulation of seed priming mechanisms to improve crop performance under threats caused by climate change (drought, heat, high light) through non-GMO practices. 
As a summary the Main Research Objectives are: 
•	to provide a “gene-to-field” applicability of new markers to produce or select varieties with an enhanced capacity for stress tolerance that, in the long term, will serve as a framework for knowledge transfer to other Brassica crops, to which various leafy vegetables, cauliflower/broccoli, mustard, and turnip belong.
 Oilseed rape is ideally suited to undertake the EpiSeedLink research program. On one hand, oilseed rape is Europe’s most important oils crop (for cereal and biofuel production) and is closely related to the model plant Arabidopsis. On the other hand, it is affected by environmental threats during the critical phases of germination and field emergence, such that the drought in 2018/19 caused up to 44% losses in the EU. The expertise of the BioAtlantis and DSV companies will beneficite as to achieve our objective.
•	 Provide excellent know-how, and improve research and complementary skills of 11 early-stage scientists

Name: Adaptam Therapeutics
Description:
Adaptam Therapeutics is pioneering next-generation cancer immunotherapies by disrupting the immunosuppressive myeloid tumor microenvironment (TME) through glyco-immune checkpoints. 

The TME in solid tumors is enriched in immunosuppressive myeloid cells, such as tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), which drive resistance or a lack of response to existing treatments. This remains one of the toughest challenges in cancer immunotherapy. Our discoveries in cancer immunology, T cell and myeloid cell biology have revealed previously unexplored cancer dependencies, demonstrating that specific glycan interactions with immune cells are key drivers of myeloid-mediated immune suppression.

Adaptam is advancing a pipeline of first-in-class, antibody-based therapies targeting these central glycobiology pathways involved in myeloid immunosuppression. Our in-house antibody discovery expertise enables the development of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and bispecific antibodies targeting the immunosuppressive TME. Focused on solid tumors, our programs are designed to transform cancer treatment across multiple indications by reprogramming the immunosuppressive tumor landscape while boosting T cell activity.

A spin-off from CIC bioGUNE, Adaptam is supported by founding investor Criteria Bio Ventures and has secured competitive national and European funding, including several prestigious European Research Council (ERC) grants.
