En 2019 fue seleccionada dentro del programa CLIMATE-KIC, como uno de los proyectos startup para el desarrollo de tecnología para envases de alimentos disminuyendo el desperdicio de comida y eliminando los residuos plásticos que generan los envases.

Contamos con tecnología propia y licenciada por el CSIC, para la encapsulación de principios activos en soportes como zeolitas, sepiloitas, bentonitas, polisacaridos, silices, microcapsulas, organoarcillas y otros, con los que después se fabrican envases activos.

Los aditivos desarrollados por ENCAPSULAE preservan los alimentos del deterioro desde el envase, permitiendo alargar la vida útil del alimento, mediante soluciones como la absorción de oxigeno, reducción de bacterias, filtros de luz solar, liberación de antioxidantes, etc...

Una vez los envases han sido usados, se convierten en un residuo que si no se recicla adecuadamente tarda cientos de años en degradarse. ENCAPSULAE cuenta con aditivos para la aceleración de la degradación de polímeros para que una vez el envase se haya usado este se pueda degradar en menos de 180 días siguiendo la norma EN-13432.

Name: Al Jord Lab
Description:
The Mechanics of Organelle Remodeling Laboratory is located within the Centre for Genomic Regulation at the PRBB on the coast line of Barcelona, Spain.
 
Our Lab’s general mission is to understand how mechanical forces impact nuclear genetic messages in health, aging, and disease. In particular, our group’s interdisciplinary research aims to decipher how cytoskeletal forces impact nuclear dynamics across scales, with a focus on the mechano-regulation of nuclear biomolecular condensates & RNA processing.
 
To attain this aim, our research follows a cross-disciplinary approach, bridging methods from systems, cell, molecular, and synthetic biology along with computational and biophysical tools. This comprises techniques like protein multiplexing, advanced live and super-resolution imaging, optogenetics, spatial transcriptomics, biomimetic systems, and force measurement and modulation assays.

Name: UNLOCK project
Description:
15 partners from 7 EU countries work together to transform waste from the poultry industry into bio-based products for agricultural applications. 

The UNLOCK project, funded by the Bio-based Industries Joint Undertaking (BBI JU), aims at designing economically and environmentally sustainable innovative value chains to create a feather based bio-economy. 

In the course for the four-years project, the feathers will be valorised through four different processes, from mechanical treatment to steam explosion, microbial fermentaion or chemical hydrolysis, depending on the type of end products desired. 

The bio-based products generated will be tailored to the needs of the agriculture sector, with the creation of seed trays, nonwoven geotextiles, mulch films and hydroponic foams. Futhermore, the keratin contained in those innovative materials will bring additional environmental benefits at the end of the product’s life: keratin-based materials are targeted to be zero waste and allow for controlled biodegradability, while also enriching soils with organic nitrogen. 

The UNLOCK project is lead by the CIDETEC Foundation. It receives funding from the @EU_H2020 Research & Innovation Programme granted by 
@BBI2020 under grant agreement no 101023306. It officially started on 1st May 2021 and will run until April 2025.

Name: Biotechnological Processes Unit from IMDEA Energy
Description:
In the Biotechnological Processes Unit, we work essentially on the production of biofuels and bioproducts through the development of biological processes using different residual substrates and different microorganisms depending on the product we want to obtain. 

Our Research Lines are:
• Anaerobic fermentation of waste streams for SCFAs and biogas production. 
• Microbial oils production from the carboxylic platform (SCFAs). 
• Lignocellulose-based biofuels and bioproducts. 
• Organic wastes valorization towards alternative food-protein sources. 

The infrastructures of the Biotechnological Processes Unit include several laboratories and a modern pilot plant for the cultivation of photosynthetic microorganisms in photobioreactors, which allows us to optimize and scale up the cultivation of microalgae. We also have an anaerobic reactor with a volume of 50 liters, which also allows us to scale up fermentation processes.

The R&D projects with which we are associated are:

- MADRID VUELA SOSTENIBLE: to create and develop an innovation HUB for the production of sustainable aviation fuels (SAF).
- YAF: Yeast-based solutions for sustainable Aviation Fuels.
- RESOPLA: Municipal green residues as novel substrates for sustainable bioplastic production via anaerobic fermentation.
- RAVIOLIC: Agroindustry waste valorization into bioethanol by an innovative anaerobic mixed-culture.
- BIOMIO: Biowaste conversion to H2 and microbial oils for fuel production.
- UPGRES: Production of sustainable fuels by upgrading of both digestate and stillage residues through the integration of thermochemical, catalytic and biotechnological processes.

Name: it ́s biology
Description:
Who we are
We are a team of computational biologists with great biological knowledge, crucial experience in laboratory wet lab procedures and last but not least a vast know-how in the analysis of microarray and Next-Generation-Sequencing (NGS) data. We think, that knowledge of the underlying biological theory and actually having been working with biological assays really helps in interpreting high-level experimental data. We have been successfully working for research institutes and pharmaceutical companies on a world-wide level. We are sure, that we can help you in any stage of your data analysis.

What we offer
It's biology offers start to finish data analysis of a broad range of Next-Generation-Sequencing applications like RNA-Seq, DNA-Seq, Chip-Seq and more. We do not use standard pipelines, instead we adapt the workflow based on experimental design, aim of the investigator and most important data inherent specialities, which can't be addressed by standard procedures. We carefully select from a broad range of possible alignment algorithms, normalization and quantification procedures (RNA-Seq), peak callers (Chip-Seq), Variations (DNA-Seq) and statistical tests, all in order to obtain the best result possible. Please have a look at our Portfolio, where we make explicit examples.
We are working with data from all mayor sequencing technologies, from Illumina, Ion-Torrent and Solid machines.

And some more
We will not stop with a list of significant genes, transcripts, alternative splice events or peaks. We offer a broad spectrum of biological interpretation strategies like Gene Ontology (GO) or Pathway enrichment various clustering strategies (SOM, K-Means, hierarchical clustering) and powerful visualizations. We will ensure, that you will receive carefully designed, high resolution images for any step of the analysis.

For us a dot in a scatter plot is not just a dot. It's biology.

Innovigilancia supports organisations at decision points where risks carry material clinical, strategic, or asset-level consequences, even when evidence is incomplete or uncertainty is high.

The focus of Innovigilancia is early medical assessment of risk, as well as the medical evaluation and management of risks identified through safety signals, including proportionate risk-minimisation measures and labelling input, before they result in avoidable delay, restriction, or loss of value.

Innovigilancia is frequently engaged in situations such as:

Medical risk assessment prior to First-Time-in-Man (FTIM)
Independent medical evaluation of new safety signals including DRESS/DILI
Signal interpretation with potential impact on development, labelling, or programme viability
Medical and benefit–risk input for first-time or high-risk EU submissions
Design and justification of proportionate risk-minimisation strategies
Medical input to due diligence before or after funding, in-licensing, or acquisition

Expertise includes complex and programme-limiting safety issues such as DILI, DRESS, and other Emerging Safety Issues (ESIs), where senior medical judgement is required to support defensible development, regulatory, and investment decisions.

Innovigilancia provides independent senior medical input and strategic direction.

Engagements are selective, assignment-based, and focused on clarity, proportionality, and decisions that can be medically and scientifically defended over time.

Colorectal cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Our approach offers a low cost, easy to use alternative compatible with population-based screening programs and point-of-care settings.

GreenBioPeptides | Plant-Based Precision Biotechnology for Health, Beauty & Sustainability

GreenBioPeptides is a pioneering biotech startup dedicated to the discovery and development of Bioactive Peptide Extracts (BPEs) derived from medicinal plants, aromatic herbs, and nutrient-rich vegetal foods. At GreenBioPeptides, we offer B2B innovation for companies seeking next-generation ingredients safe, traceable, and backed by science. Whether you're formulating skincare, functional supplements, or health-boosting solutions, our plant-based actives deliver real, measurable benefits.

We believe the future of biotechnology lies at the intersection of nature and molecular precision, where sustainability meets functionality, and innovation is grounded in evidence.

Name: GREEN SEA BIO SYSTEM ONE (GSBS)
Description: GSBS Believes in the future of Micro-Algae Cultivation Plants and in the endless possibilities they offer. In addition to being more than just biomass and nutrient producers, they can also be a source of clean energy such as electricity, and other essentials goods such as drinking water. These plants are useful for cleaning the planet abating two major causes of pollution like CO2 and urban solid waste. The system is based on a closed, continous production process that incorporates biological cycles whithin a well balanced technological process. With this technology an Autonomous Village can be created that is capable of addressing modern day issues such as Energy scarcity, Water supply, Pollution, Nutrition and Unemployment. The plant designed by GSBS based on seven years of experience provides for the cultivation of unicellular-algae in an aqueous medium. The entire farming process takes place within a photo-unit into which a gas stream containing CO2 is injected. The algae are then harvested, accumulated, compressed and further treated to obtain a biomass with controlled moisture content. From this biomass, lipids, fatty acids, amino acids and proteins are extracted. The positive energy balance of the process -meaning that the entire process does not use more energy than it can produce- is obtained by the parallel exploitation of other renewable energy sources to offset on-site energy consumption.

Name: Structural Bioinformatics and Network Biology Lab (SBNB Lab)
Description:
The Structural Bioinformatics and Network Biology Lab, led by Dr. Patrick Aloy at the IRB Barcelona, is a leading computational research group dedicated to understanding the molecular architecture of life and disease.

We leverage cutting-edge bioinformatics, network modeling, and structural biology techniques to analyze how proteins interact and how biological systems are organized. Our work transforms complex biological data into predictive models and actionable insights.

Our primary mission is to translate fundamental research into clinical and biomedical applications, accelerating drug discovery and advancing the realization of personalized medicine.

Focus Areas:
- Computational Structural Biology
- Protein-Protein Interaction Networks
- Disease Mechanisms and Drug Target Identification
- AI/ML for Biological Data Analysis

Name: Generitca exotic miniatures
Description:
Executive Summary:
The purpose of this white paper is to explore the feasibility and potential of creating miniature felines through genetic modification techniques. The paper will examine the current market demand for exotic miniatures, the ethical implications of genetic modification, and the regulatory and legal framework for creating genetically modified animals.

Market Demand:
The market for exotic miniatures has seen steady growth in recent years, with many pet owners looking for unique and rare pets. The creation of miniature felines through genetic modification could offer a new product in this market, appealing to those interested in owning a one-of-a-kind pet.

Ethical Implications:
The creation of genetically modified animals raises ethical concerns related to animal welfare and the potential impact on the environment and human health. It is important to consider these concerns before pursuing the creation of miniature felines in a genetic laboratory.

Regulatory and Legal Framework:
Creating genetically modified animals may require regulatory approval and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. It is important to understand the regulatory and legal framework before pursuing this endeavor.

Conclusion:
In conclusion, the creation of miniature felines in a genetic laboratory has the potential to offer a unique product in the growing market for exotic miniatures. However, it is important to carefully consider the ethical implications and regulatory requirements before pursuing this endeavor.

• Managing this waste is a problem and an environmental challenge given the lack of high-value-added solutions that are technically and economically viable.
SOLUTION: TECHNOLOGIES & PRODUCTS
• Mollusks: technology in patent process that allows the production of Calcium L-pidolate (CAS 31377-05-6) and Calcium levulinate dihydrate (CAS 5743-49-7). Advantages: much greater bioavailability, absorption capacity, preservation, and safe dosage.
• Crustaceans: obtaining glucosamine hydrochloride (CAS 3416-24-8) from crustacean exoskeletons and cephalopod feathers.
• Fish: optimized process for extracting hydrolyzed marine collagen from the skin and carcasses of various species such as tilapia.
• Technological know-how: chemical, biological, and enzymatic hydrolysis processes; extraction and purification of molecules; synthesis of derivatives; physicochemical characterization of substances using various techniques.
SERVICES
• Technology partner for marine biomass generating companies to implement innovative, scalable, and high-value-added circular economy models
• Supplier of APIs, compounds, and formulations for companies in the nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food, petfood, and veterinary sectors
• Customized R&D projects.

Name: IKERLAT Polymers S.L.
Description:
IKERLAT Polymers is a specialist in the development and manufacture of personalized polymer particles. At present, with a background of fifteen years, the company has been consolidated as a reference in the market of polymeric dispersions.
Our polymer particles are mainly used in diagnostic systems, acting as magnifiers of antigen-antibody reactions. Other uses include photonic crystals, colloidal models, calibration and verification processes...
Personalization, quality, reproducibility and R&D are the pillars over which IKERLAT Polymers stands.

Name: Bioceanics
Description:
Bioceanics es una empresa de biotecnología con visión de futuro comprometida con el desarrollo de productos y servicios transformadores en la intersección de la tecnología verde y los recursos marinos. Nuestra misión es clara: mejorar tanto la salud humana como la salud de nuestro planeta.

En el corazón de nuestra empresa se encuentra «Biokrill», nuestra plataforma tecnológica insignia; Procesos y moléculas novedosos que aprovechan plenamente los beneficios del aceite de krill, sin la carga ambiental de la recolección tradicional de krill en la Antártida.

La versatilidad de nuestros productos se extiende más allá de los suplementos dietéticos, con un potencial prometedor en el mercado de la cosmética y en el descubrimiento de fármacos, basados en los componentes del krill.

Detrás de escena, Bioceanics es el resultado de un esfuerzo de colaboración entre Ivoro Ventures, la Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, el catedrático D. Javier Señorans y 4Ammonium Biotech SL. Su experiencia y dedicación han sido fundamentales para hacer realidad esta visión.

 Nuestra misión se extiende más allá del desarrollo de productos. Estamos comprometidos a generar un impacto duradero en la industria y fomentar la sostenibilidad. En Bioceanics estamos ansiosos por compartir más sobre nuestros proyectos e iniciativas en curso.
Location: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: FindYourTrial
Description:
Trial Search Made Easy!

At FindYourTrial, we are revolutionizing how patients locate and recruit for clinical trials. 

 Our platform uses AI-powered technology to collect data on Clinical Trials from official sources, making locating desired trials easier and accelerating the recruitment process. 

 Our goal is to empower patients by simplifying and facilitating the search for applicable clinical trials, helping to make clinical research more accessible to everyone.

Name: Noray Biosciences Group
Description: Noray BG es un grupo empresarial vasco, enfocado a las Biociencias, cuya misión es gestionar e integrar empresas del sector para facilitar su acceso al mercado y su internacionalización. Noray BG está actualmente compuesto por tres empresas: Histocell, ArtinVet y NorayBio.

Name: AEBA - Asociación de Empresas de Biotecnología de la Provincia de Alicante
Description:
AEBA (Asociación Empresarial de Biotecnología de Alicante) nace en la provincia de Alicante con los objetivos de defender los intereses comunes del sector biotecnológico, la necesidad de mejorar su competitividad y la búsqueda de puntos de encuentro en la generación de sinergias potenciales.

Se trata de un sector emergente y estratégico por la transversalidad de sus aplicaciones al resto de actividades y por sus efectos en la cadena de valor de los procesos, con amplias potencialidades en la mejora productos y en el desarrollo de otros nuevos.

La biotecnología se puede entender como el área del conocimiento que utiliza técnicas y tecnologías que a su vez utilizan organismos o parte de ellos y sus aplicaciones.

Se trata de un área que está creciendo y ganando peso, con un aumento de su impacto tanto en el ámbito social como en el económico a través de los avances que se van produciendo y de su incorporación progresiva a los procesos productivos de sector empresarial.

Name: 3D liver virtual modeling reconstruction - REMOVIRT H3D
Description:
This project aims to provide the clinician with a 3D digital twin of the liver and all its structures and lesions, based on Computed Tomography (CT) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) images, in an automated manner using artificial vision, machine learning techniques and artificial intelligence.

Grant  “Generación del conocimiento” PID2022-142709OA-C22 / PID2022-142709OB-C21 funded by MCIN/AEI/ 10.13039/501100011033 and, as appropriate, by “ERDF A way of making Europe”.

Name: Aerofybers Technologies
Description:
We create biodegradable cellulose-based aerogels in line with the current need for more sustainable materials.

Our mission is to provide a sustainable alternative to current porous materials and conventional aerogels whose biodegradability rates do not follow current zero-waste and circular economy policies. Thanks to our patented methodology, our reinforced cellulose-based aerogels are able to possess an optimum balance between high-performance, processability (both mechanical and humidity resistant), and sustainability.
Moreover, our raw materials are completely obtained from renewable sources or by-products (vine shoots, straw... etc.).

Thanks to the combination of biopolymers, our aerogels present excellent properties such as:
- Improved mechanical and humidity/water resistance
- Acoustic/Thermal insulation
- Biodegradability

As a result, our aerogels can be applied in several fields such as:
- Isothermal packaging
- Acoustic/Heat insulation in green buildings
- Agriculture
- Biomedicine

08193, Barcelona.

Name: Alperpack
Description:
Transforming olive by-products into sustainable materials, natural ingredients and circular bioeconomy solutions.
Alperpack is an Andalusian bioeconomy startup focused on the advanced valorisation of olive pomace, one of the largest agricultural by-products generated by the olive oil industry.
Our mission is to unlock the full value of olive pomace through science, innovation and industrial collaboration, transforming agricultural residues into new sources of economic, environmental and social value.

We are developing innovative solutions in:

 Sustainable packaging and biomaterials

 Natural ingredients and functional compounds

 Circular economy and agricultural waste valorisation

 Bio-based materials and industrial applications

 Climate-positive and regenerative solutions

Alperpack works alongside research institutions, industry partners and European innovation ecosystems to accelerate the transition towards a more sustainable and circular economy.

We believe that agricultural by-products should not be treated as waste, but as strategic resources capable of generating new industries, rural opportunities and positive environmental impact.

Selected participant in the EIT Food EWA M2 2026 Programme and collaborating with the University of Córdoba on the development and validation of innovative applications derived from olive pomace.

 From olive by-products to the industries of the future.

 Andalusia, Spain

Name: Origen Biomédica SL
Description:
ORIGEN BIOMÉDICA—SOBRE NOSOTROS
Origen Biomédica S.L. se fundó en 2016, sobre la base del conocimiento y el aprendizaje de sus socios fundadores. La experiencia acumulada durante más de 20 años nos ha servido para establecer unos cimientos sólidos, y tener claro nuestros objetivos y nuestro recorrido para llegar a ellos. Desde el campo de la Neurología, la Neurofisiología, la Rehabilitación, la Biomecánica, o la Robótica, ofrecemos soluciones integrales a los especialistas y a sus pacientes.

MISIÓN Y OBJETIVO
La misión de la empresa es proporcionar herramientas eficaces para el diagnóstico y el tratamiento de enfermedades neurológicas, neuromusculares, musculares, y todas aquellas que requieran de un equipamiento avanzado e innovador para dicha misión. Esto permitirá trabajar en la prevención de patologías, en pacientes con indicios de poder sufrir una enfermedad, y también desarrollar un tratamiento acorde, incluso en estadios previos a la aparición de las enfermedades, lo que redunda, de un modo definitivo, en la salud de los pacientes.

El objetivo de la empresa, es desarrollar y comercializar productos innovadores de un modo autónomo, tanto propios como de terceros.

VALORES
Origen Biomédica S.L. es una compañía con unos valores definidos, que implican un compromiso con el especialista para ofrecerle productos de calidad, y acompañarlo en su desarrollo profesional. Desde la honestidad, queremos ofrecer a nuestros usuarios, todo nuestro conocimiento de una forma clara y precisa, y lo hacemos transfiriendo ese conocimiento a los productos innovadores que ofrecemos. En nuestra mente también está, como fin último, el dotar a los pacientes de ayudas para la mejora de sus patologías, que redunden en su bienestar físico y mental. Con todo ello, devolvemos a la sociedad, una parte de lo que la sociedad nos ha permitido crear y desarrollar, contribuiyedo así, al crecimiento y bienestar colectivo.

Name: GRHECO-Xen
Description:
This research group has focused on the application of advanced information technologies in the field of oncohematologic tumors. These approaches, reflected in the diversity of our investigations, have centered on the following main objectives:

Identification of driver genes in oncogenesis and tumor progression in hematologic neoplasms.
Identification of recurrently altered signaling pathways in the genome of hematologic tumors.
Development of prognostic machine learning models in different types of oncohematologic neoplasms based on clinical and molecular information.
Development of predictive models of drug response or drug combinations based on the integration of molecular and clinical variables.
Research Lines

Development of new prognostic models based on data from national and international collaborative groups.
Standardization of clinical and molecular models to improve risk stratification in patients with hematologic neoplasms, particularly lymphomas, myelomas, and myeloid neoplasms.
Development of new scores to predict drug response within clinical trials.
Creation of new computer vision systems to infer prognostic patterns based on deep neural networks and transfer learning.
Optimization of preclinical drug development using computational tools, including machine learning models.

Name: Bio Optical Detection S.L.
Description:
Technology Based Company of the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, prize for the second Innovative Idea under the Actúa-UPM Programme.
In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) by label-free optical interrogation of biosensors.

The majority of the bioassays that are used today relay on labeled detection schemes, but these techniques may have a limited flexibility due to the need of using multiple reagents. Opposite to labeled techniques, label-free technologies are achieving promising results since they offer several advantages for IVD: accuracy, precisión, sensitivity, short turn-around time, easy and label-free operation, real time análisis and cost-effectiveness.
Location: Mejorada del Campo, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: ProInsectFeed
Description:
ProinsectFeed- Proteína sostenible de insectos para la producción de aves y porcinos. 

Grupo Operativo compuesto por Entomo AgroIndustrial, CEFU SA, ALIMER, Estrella de Levante y Avícola Levantina con la colaboración de Universidad Católica San Antonio y  Eurovértice como Agente de Innovación. 

Nuestro objetivo es el desarrollo de un proyecto de innovación para validar un prototipo comercial sostenible de harina de insectos para alimentación avícola y porcina. 
En este proyecto los subproductos agroalimentarios de la Región de Murcia servirán de alimentos para insectos, y el engorde y procesamiento de estos, dará como resultado una harina rica en nutrientes que será probada como dieta de aves y porcinos. 

Proyecto cofinanciado por el Fondo Europeo Agrícola de Desarrollo Rural y el Instituto Murcia de Investigación y Desarrollo Agrario y Medioambiental.

Description:
RIVER Crop Protection Corp. es una Compañía Internacional que desarrolla FITOSANITARIOS ENTOMOPATÓGENOS y ELICITORES, formulados con Extractos Enzimáticos de MICROORGANISMOS y ELICITORES (Polifenoles, Péptidos Antimicrobianos PAM ́s, Betaglucanos, Oligosacáridos, Oxipilinas, etc), Los ELICITORES son moléculas que se encuentran en las paredes celulares de los Extractos Vegetales, que junto a los MICROORGANISMOS consiguen inducir mecanismos de CONTROL y AUTODEFENSA en los Cultivos exentos de LÍMITE MÁXIMO de RESIDUOS (LRM), con #CEROPESTICIDAS, #CERORESÍDUOS y #CERODÍASPARACORTE.
 

Los FITOSANITARIOS ELICITORES de RIVER Crop son inductores de defensa que EVITAN LA APARICIÓN DE RESISTENCIA A LOS PATÓGENOS.

RIVER Crop Protection Corp. revoluciona en los últimos 15 años el mercado BIOTECNOLÓGICO convirtiendo a  RIVER Crop en uno de los PIONEROS EN AGRICULTURA SUSTENTABLE.
Location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Canary Islands, Spain

Name: Grupo de Biomateriales
Description:
La actividad del Grupo de Biomateriales del ICTP-CSIC se centra principalmente en dos líneas de investigación claramente diferenciadas: el desarrollo de sistemas de liberación controlada de moléculas bioactivas y en el desarrollo de andamios para ingeniería de tejidos. Ambas líneas confluyen continuamente dando lugar a biomateriales y dispositivos médicos de altas prestaciones.

El Grupo está especializado en:

    Síntesis y preparación de monómeros con actividad farmacológica (antitrombogénica, antiinflamatoria, antitumoral, antiangiogénica, etc)
    Síntesis y preparación de polímeros bioactivos con acción terapéutica específica
    Síntesis de polímeros nanoestructurados para la preparación sistemas autoensamblados
    Modificación de polímeros naturales para el desarrollo hidrogeles
    Desarrollo de materiales compuestos de aplicación en biomedicina
    Estudio de los efectos biológicos de lo biomateriales en células eucariotas y procariotas. Determinación de citotoxicidad y biocompatibilidad, estudios de inflamación, estudios de efecto anticancerígeno, apoptosis. Actividad antimicrobiana utilizando bacterias gram+ y gram-
    Ensayos animales in vivo en colaboración con otras instituciones (Universidad de Salamanca, Universidad de Alcalá de Henares, Hospital Puerta de Hierro-Majadahonda, Hospital Ramón y Cajal...)

Todo ello se traduce en contribuciones relevantes para el desarrollo de nuevas nanopartículas bioactivas para el transporte y liberación de moléculas bioactivas (e.g. medicamentos, vitaminas, iRNA, factores de crecimiento, etc), hidrogeles y biotintas de impresión 3D para ingeniería de tejidos, recubrimientos de dispositivos biomédicos, etc.

El Grupo tiene una clara vocación de transferencia y gran parte de su investigación la lleva a cabo en colaboración con empresas farmacéuticas o de dispositivos médicos.

Name: Unidad de Investigación Biomédica Universidad Alfonso X el Sabio (UIB-UAX)
Description:
La Unidad de Investigación Biomédica de la Universidad Alfonso X el Sabio (UIB-UAX) tiene como objetivo divulgar la ciencia que se realiza en nuestro laboratorio, compartiendo nuestros proyectos, seminarios, charlas, publicaciones y eventos al estilo #UAXmaker.

Buscamos crecer como unidad de investigación, y al mismo tiempo introducir y formar a estudiantes en el mundo de la ciencia y la investigación experimental, fomentando su aprendizaje y participación activa en nuestros proyectos.

Nuestro equipo invita a la comunidad científica, estudiantes y público general a seguir nuestras actividades y descubrimientos, promoviendo un espacio de aprendizaje, colaboración y pasión por la investigación.
Location: Villanueva de la Cañada, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: Snorkel Spain
Description: At Snorkel Spain, we’re working to develop high-quality companion seeds, plant nutrients, and soil enhancers. Our passion for organic agriculture, regenerative methods, and working with—instead of against—nature underpins everything we do. We firmly believe optimal yields and healthy plants can be achieved through boosting soil health, promoting biodiversity, and utilising effective biological controls in the garden.

Name: Amets Biotechnology
Description: Founded in 2025, Amets Biotechnology SL is a biotechnology company dedicated to the development of innovative gene therapies for rare pediatric diseases. Building on a strong scientific foundation and led by a management team with international expertise in gene therapy, Amets Biotechnology combines deep technological know-how with strategic vision and a proven track record in translational drug development, from discovery through to clinical trials, to advance its pipeline and position itself as a global reference in next-generation gene therapies.
Location: Pamplona, Chartered Community of Navarre, Spain

Name: iGEM Barcelona-UB
Description:
We are the iGEM Barcelona UB 2025 team, engineering a new generation of RNA-based genetic switches to transform how gene expression is controlled in synthetic biology.

Our project focuses on creating compact, ligand-responsive RNA tools that operate without the need for proteins or genome editing. By enabling precise, modular, and programmable gene regulation at the RNA level, we aim to unlock powerful new applications in biotechnology, from smart therapeutics to cellular biosensors and industrial bioprocesses.

Committed to innovation, open science, and accessibility, we are building tools that make advanced RNA engineering available to everyone.

Name: Phyture Biotech S.L.
Description:
Formerly known as Phyture Biotech, Vytrus Biotech is a pioneer company in Spain that offers an innovative proposal: a new generation of plant extracts. The company is specialized in the development, production and commercialization of high value active ingredients from the technology of plant stem cells,  for dermocosmetic applications. Launched in 2015, the Plant Cell BiofactoriesTM (PCB) Technology Platform allows the company to obtain the advantages of molecular synergy, since plant stem cells contain a large quantity of proactive essential substances that perform in a synergic way along with the derma-cosmetic active principles of interest, contributing to improved effectiveness of the product.

Description: We are a biotechnology company committed to the health of the planet and the beings that inhabit it. Name: ATLAS MOLECULAR PHARMA
Description:
Atlas Molecular Pharma is a biotech company focused on the discovery of first-in-class therapies for rare and ultra-rare diseases. Founded in 2015 as a spin-off of CIC bioGUNE (Bizkaia, Spain), we leverage our proprietary Chassys Platform  to identify pharmacological chaperones that stabilize defective enzymes and restore their function. Our lead candidate, ATL-001, is currently in clinical development for Congenital Erythropoietic Porphyria (CEP), an ultra-rare metabolic disease with no existing therapies.

At Atlas Molecular Pharma, we are committed to providing innovative solutions for patients living with rare and ultra-rare diseases.

What we do
–	Discover novel drug candidates through our Chassys Platform.
–	Develop pharmacological chaperones targeting severe metabolic disorders with no current therapies.
–	Advance ATL-001 in clinical development for Congenital Erythropoietic Porphyria (CEP), a devastating ultra-rare metabolic disorder.

Our vision
To become a trusted innovation partner in rare disease drug discovery, delivering hope and life-changing treatments to underserved patient communities.

Name: BrainGuard
Description: BrainGuard is the first company that predicts in an objective, accurate and personalized way the onset of a migraine by unobtrusive monitoring of hemodynamic signals. BrainGuard helps migraineurs letting them know in advance of the onset of a migraine to act and avoid the pain improving their quality of life. To change the paradigm of the disease, BrainGuard provides a personalized disease treatment based on prescriptions of their trusted doctor.

Forchronic es una empresa biotech, basada en el conocimiento de la Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, que desarrolla nuevos complementos nutricionales y nutracéuticos de precisión con acción inmunomoduladora para la prevención de enfermedades.

Description: Biomol-Informatics offers consulting services on Bioinformatics in areas of research, diagnostics and pharmaceutical industry. Located at the campus of the Autonomous University of Madrid, the company specializes in Rational Drug Design using 3D computational simulation, Molecular Dynamics of macromolecules and Data Analysis of Next-Generation DNA Sequencing.

Description: ZVIT medical es una compañía especializada productos avanzados no invasivos para implantología  y regeneración ósea  dirigidos a neurocirugías, maxilofacial y cirugía oral.

Name: ZRO Imaging
Description:
ZRO Imaging (ZRO) is a neuroimaging CRO focused on biomarker-driven clinical studies in neurodegenerative disease. We partner with biopharma and diagnostics companies to design and execute imaging strategies that reduce risk, accelerate timelines, and strengthen decision-making.

Our work spans PET and MRI from early-phase through late-stage development, including radiotracer evaluation, quantitative imaging, and multimodal biomarker integration. We support study design, protocol development, central analysis, and interpretation — with a focus on generating clinically meaningful, trial-ready data.

We combine scientific depth with a lean, execution-focused model. Clients work directly with senior experts, enabling faster decisions, flexible scope, and rigorous, fit-for-purpose imaging solutions.

ZRO stands for zero delays, zero unnecessary complexity — and a future with zero neurodegenerative diseases.

Name: Exostatics Pharmaceuticals
Description:
Exostatics Pharmaceuticals S.L. is a biotech company, spin-off from the University of Bordeaux (France). The company has developed a patented technology based on synthetic chemosensors for the efficient isolation of exosomes and other circulating microvesicles from biological fluids (urine, plasma, etc.) for use in the diagnosis and prognosis of diseases. 

The patented compound has been validated in a proof of concept with urine and plasma samples for the detection of nephropathies, obtaining promising results in the uptake of these extracellular vesicles.

By not targeting a specific biomarker and with a simpler laboratory process which preserves the integrity of exosomes, we provide a broader set of applications both for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes, across multiple health conditions.

Name: CPLab
Description: We study the mutualistic relationships between cyanobacteria and crop plants, with the aim of obtaining new biofertilizers for crop production. Some cyanobacteria, able to fix atmospheric nitrogen (N2), use photosynthesis as the primary source of energy to assimilate this element, and are known for their enormous contribution to nitrogen and carbon cycles in the biosphere. Some cyanobacteria genera live in symbiosis with plants, providing nitrogen to the host. The use of biofertilizers containing these symbiotic cyanobacteria constitutes a sustainable alternative to nitrogen fertilizers, reducing the environmental risk associated to our current agronomic techniques.

Name: MAGic-MOLFUN
Description:
The MAGic-MOLFUN doctoral network (DN) will train the next generation of specialists to transform natural products research. 

The next generation of specialists will be educated in a combination of wet-lab and computational skills to integrate genome mining and metabolomics with cutting-edge pathway discovery- and engineering approaches. There is a fast-growing demand for these combinations of skills, but these are rarely taught in current integrated training programs. These multidisciplinary skills and qualifications will be acquired while achieving the scientific goals of the program, namely understanding and developing the complex biosynthesis and production of microbial NPs for cross-sector applications such as medicine, food, agriculture, or biotechnology. Specifically, the Doctoral Candidates (DCs) will work in three areas:

    1) develop novel computational tools and algorithms to improve the identification and prediction quality of biosynthetic gene clusters encoding NP biosynthesis in genomic data. This genome-centered approach is complemented by
   2)  the use of cheminformatics approaches to link metabolomics data of NPs with the genomic data of the producers, which will greatly improve the compound discovery and dereplication process. These two data-centric approaches will finally
    3) converge into experimental applications that discover and characterize novel NPs with promising bioactivities (e.g., antibiotics, pre-/probiotics, agrichemicals, bio-pigments).

The scientific training program is complemented by a comprehensive transferable skill training that will equip the DCs for todays’ demands of a successful career in industry and academia. The skills obtained in the DN will enable the DCs to work not only in natural product research but also many other data-intensive areas of biotechnology.

“This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 101072485”.

Hifas Veterinary S.L., la división veterinaria del grupo Hifas da Terra, es una empresa de biotecnología centrada en la investigación y desarrollo de complementos nutricionales y núcleos de ingredientes funcionales cuya misión principal se basa en el desarrollo de soluciones eficaces e innovadoras para satisfacer la creciente demanda de productos naturales para alimentación animal.

Somos un equipo de veterinarios, biólogos, médicos, microbiólogos, farmacéuticos y genetistas, líderes en salud humana desde hace más de 20 años en suplementos alimenticios. Trabajamos para mejorar cada día y para continuar innovando en productos e ingredientes funcionales que cuiden de las personas, de las mascotas, de los animales de producción y del medio ambiente, dentro del enfoque global ‘ONE HEALTH – UNA SOLA SALUD’, en el que el profesional veterinario está en el centro de nuestro negocio.

Proporcionamos a nuestras mascotas y animales de productos naturales innovadores en cuya composición, las moléculas bioactivas de los hongos medicinales (reino Fungi) juegan un papel esencial en la prevención y tratamiento de enfermedades.

Name: Vita 34 - Secuvita
Description:
Secuvita S.L. es una empresa española dedicada a la obtención, procesamiento y conservación de células madre de sangre de cordón umbilical. Secuvita pertenece al Grupo Vita 34 Internacional AG. 

Vita 34 se creó en Alemania en 1997 y fue el primer Banco Familiar de sangre de cordón umbilical de Europa. 
Desde el inicio se ha reconocido al Grupo como líder en calidad y seguridad en la conservación de células madre de sangre de cordón umbilical, así como referente en investigación con células madre.

Nuestra dilatada experiencia y la optimización continua de procesos y materiales, nos llevan a obtener mejores muestras de células madre y a su conservación segura durante años.

A lo largo de todo el delicado proceso, seguimos los Protocolos Normalizados de Trabajo (PNTs) exigidos por las autoridades alemanas. Igualmente, realizamos nuestra actividad de acuerdo a la normativa vigente en España y conforme a las directrices que marcan las autoridades sanitarias españolas.

Nuestro compromiso es garantizar que todos los procesos que utilizamos en la obtención y conservación de la sangre de cordón umbilical conducen a obtener el mayor número de células, para conseguir el mejor resultado en caso de trasplante. Por eso hemos elegido trabajar conforme al estándar GMP, la acreditación requerida a los laboratorios farmacéuticos.

Name: BASE4 Biosciences
Description:
BASE4 Biosciences is a precision health company building a new layer for preventive medicine. Using a single blood sample and AI-driven transcriptomic analysis, we infer the functional health and biological age of 47+ tissues, enabling early detection of organ-level deterioration before clinical symptoms appear.

Our platform combines multi-omics data and proprietary models to deliver personalized, explainable insights into disease risk, identifying the molecular pathways driving decline. Initially focused on women’s health, BASE4 aims to transform healthcare from reactive to predictive, enabling earlier intervention, better outcomes, and continuous health monitoring.

Name: Centro de Neurociencias Cajal, CNC (CSIC)
Description:
El Centro de Neurociencias Cajal (CNC) es un centro de investigación dedicado al estudio del cerebro y del sistema nervioso, con la misión de impulsar la investigación de excelencia en neurociencia en España y situarla en la vanguardia internacional.

Inaugurado en 2025 en Alcalá de Henares (Madrid), el CNC integra al Instituto Cajal (IC) y al Centro Internacional de Neurociencia Cajal (CINC), ambos pertenecientes al Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC), junto con grupos de investigación internacionales. Esta estructura unificada consolida el legado histórico del Instituto Cajal y proyecta una nueva etapa de liderazgo científico, colaboración global e innovación tecnológica.

En el CNC investigamos los fundamentos biológicos de la mente y del sistema nervioso humano para comprender cómo surge, cambia y se adapta la vida. Desde los mecanismos celulares que guían el desarrollo cerebral hasta las redes neuronales que sustentan la memoria, el pensamiento y la conducta, exploramos los principios que definen nuestra comprensión del ser humano.

“Drawing the brain” expresa nuestra forma de aproximarnos a la ciencia: observar, describir y representar el cerebro con la misma precisión, curiosidad y espíritu pionero que caracterizó a Santiago Ramón y Cajal. Su legado —dibujar para entender, trazar para descubrir— continúa guiando una investigación que no solo explica el presente, sino que abre nuevos caminos para transformar la salud, la tecnología y el conocimiento.
Location: Alcalá de Henares, Community of Madrid, Spain

Description:

Savia Biotech cuenta con un apoyo decidido del sector financiero y del productivo. Los 2.600.000 euros con los que SAVIA BIOTECH cuenta como capital social, la convierten en la mayor EBT surgida de una universidad española. 

Su objetivo es satisfacer la demanda de sus socios y el de las empresas del sector agroalimentario a la vez que potencia la investigación y el desarrollo en el ámbito agroalimentario y biotecnológico. 
Savia Biotech viene a aumentar la capacidad científica y tecnológica de las empresas productoras de semillas, a través de la investigación y el desarrollo de metodologías generadas en el ámbito de la mejora genética, patología, fisiología y genética molecular de plantas, así como la aplicación de estos resultados en empresas agroalimentarias y bioenergéticas.

La principal actividad de Savia Biotech es ofrecer un servicio especializado de análisis genético y de diagnóstico molecular, así como la investigación en procesos fisiológicos y metodologías que supongan nuevos conocimientos en el ámbito de la mejora genética de plantas. También la innovación y el desarrollo de metodologías que incrementen la fiabilidad de la selección de genotipos de interés para la mejora de la calidad y la producción hortícola. Este tipo de análisis se desvelan en la actualidad, y cada vez más, como fundamentales para abordar el estudio de enfermedades y de calidad alimentaría.

Hasta ahora el cirujano debía contar con la ayuda de una tercera persona que manejara el sistema informático bajo sus órdenes (para no romper la cadena de esterilidad), o salir él mismo del espacio estéril, consultar dicha información, y volver a lavarse antes de entrar de nuevo a operar, perdiendo hasta 20 minutos cada vez.

Con la tecnología TedCas el cirujano puede consultar la información 'in-situ', sin requerir la ayuda de una tercerca persona y, lo más importante, sin romper la cadena de esterilidad, puesto que se elimina por completo el contacto físico con el ordenador y sus periféricos.

Name: SECRETed Project H2020
Description: SECRETed is an EU-H2020 multidisciplinary project involving multiple stakeholders and with a strong participation of SMEs to fully exploit the potential of aquatic biotechnology and produce novel industrial products for the agrochemical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and chemistry sectors. SECRETed will develop novel hybrid molecules with tailor-made properties obtained from the combination of biosynthetic genes of amphiphilic compounds (biosurfactants and siderophores) produced by marine and extremophilic microorganisms. The project will focus on reutilizing previous sampling efforts by screening already collected microbial collections from previous European initiatives. Machine Learning algorithms (ML) will be deployed to reveal the genetic mechanisms responsible for their biosynthesis and to expand the chemical diversity of such bio-based compounds. To this end, databases inspection and new collected data will be employed to construct a unique microbial amphiphilic compound chemical space comprehending molecular structures, physicochemical characteristics, associated bioactivities and revealed genetic mechanisms responsible for their biosynthesis. To expand the chemical diversity and enhance the industrial sustainable exploitation of such bio-based compounds, Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) in charge of the production of these molecules will be reverse engineered by standardizing and modularizing the genetic elements comprising such clusters. Their potential benefits will be broadened by looking for Industry-driven (agrochemical, cosmetic, nutrition and health) formulations based on the engineered combinations of the genetic elements expressed in suitable microbial hosts. New strains will then be designed, built and tested in an iterative process for the development of viable and sustainable industrial processes.

Name: ComeInCell
Description:
EU Horizon Europe Funded Doctoral Network


COndensates at Membrane Scaffolds – INtegrated Systems as Synthetic CELL Compartments (ComeInCell)

ComeInCell is a European Doctoral Network at the forefront of synthetic cell research. Our mission is to develop advanced cellular mimics that integrate functional membrane structures and biomolecular condensates. By creating these next-generation synthetic cells, we aim to shed light on complex cellular mechanisms, particularly those involved in neurodegenerative diseases and membrane trafficking, as well as accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic innovation.

This ambitious project brings together a diverse team of experts in biophysics, nanotechnology, biochemistry, and bioengineering. Our doctoral candidates will receive interdisciplinary training, gaining hands-on experience with state-of-the-art methodologies and working closely with both academic institutions and industry partners.

Through ComeInCell, we’re not just advancing scientific knowledge – we’re cultivating a new generation of quantitative synthetic biologists equipped to tackle global challenges in biomedical research and biotechnology. Join us as we explore the fascinating interface between membranes and condensates, paving the way for novel therapeutic strategies and research tools!

ComeInCell is a European project funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions. DN. It is also co-funded by UK Guarantee Scheme.

Name: Allinky Biopharma
Description:
Among the therapeutic areas of partnering interest, for the top pharmaceutical companies, oncology, inflammation and CNS are the highest ranked. The market value for these indications exceeds any calculation and many approaches are being developed to gain a small percentage of such value. Unfortunately straight forward approaches to target proteins driving cancer or inflammatory diseases are not always feasible.

Important protein targets in theses diseases are undrugable through their active site, often due to off-target effects. Indeed, drugs that bind to the active site of target proteins might mimic the structure of energy substrates – for example when the protein’s active site harbors systemic energy substrates such as ATP and GTP. Accordingly, such drugs might switch off other proteins that are important for the activity of specific cells in the body.

By contrast, allosteric sites are highly specific to a given protein target and in fact, nature employs these sites to selectively modulate given proteins. Allinky has developed its own proprietary technology platform to identify allosteric sites in protein targets, and to thereafter develop allosteric compounds (small molecules) with therapeutic properties. Indeed, some top-selling drugs in the market are allosteric compounds.

Allinky is currently advancing drug development programs focused on two families of  innovative proprietary small molecules (allosteric inhibitors): AIK3 and AIK4. These therapeutic molecules are being developed to treat inflammatory diseases like COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) and AMD (age-related macular degeneration) as well as cancer driven by the Ras family of proto-oncogenes that are found in certain types of lung, colorectal and pancreatic cancer as well as lymphomas.

Name: BioINSouth
Description:
Harnessing the Bioeconomy for Regional Development in Europe 

In Europe, the bioeconomy sector is a significant economic driver, employing up to 16.9% of the labor force and contributing 8.6% to the GDP. With over 2,300 bio-based plants and biorefineries generating a turnover of €600 billion, the potential for creating 400,000 new green jobs by 2035, especially in rural and coastal areas, is immense. The bioeconomy presents a unique opportunity for regional development, particularly in rural and remote areas where traditional livelihoods are scarce. By leveraging widely distributed bioresources, these regions can foster economic growth and sustainability. However, this growth must be managed carefully to protect natural ecosystems and ensure sustainable practices.

 Continuous assessment of environmental impacts is crucial to minimize negative effects and maintain ecological balance.  Adoption of policies that promote environmental sustainability and adaptive governance is essential for the bioeconomy to thrive.  Addressing regional differences is vital. While some regions excel in bioeconomy, others, like Southern Europe, face challenges such as resource scarcity, climate change, and demographic trends that hinder growth.

Designed to tackle these challenges, BioINSouth aims to bridge the gap, fostering regional development through a sustainable and circular bio-based economy. By aligning with the EU Biodiversity Strategy and European Green Deal objectives, BioINSouth supports the green and fair transition needed for a resilient future.

Let's work together to unlock the full potential of the bioeconomy, driving regional development and ensuring a sustainable future for all! 

#Bioeconomy #RegionalDevelopment #Sustainability #GreenJobs #EU #BioINSouth

Description:

Las líneas generales del sistema son: captación de los gases de emisión, lavado, filtrado y atemperado de los mismos hasta la inyección del CO2 y el NOx  en fotobioreactores que contienen un cultivo de microalgas y/o cianobacterias.

En el actual  contexto mundial de tendencia hacia la descarbonización de los procesos productivos nuestro sistema colabora activamente en la disminución del impacto industrial sobre el cambio climático añadiendo un sistema productivo generador de ingresos a través de la comercialización de biomasa algal.

The CIRCULAR BIOCARBON biorefinery will be implemented in two locations: Zaragoza (Spain) and Sesto San Giovanni (Italy). At both sites, the biorefinery will be operated for three years. In Spain, the biorefinery will be established by URBASER in collaboration with SOCAMEX, while in Italy it will be performed by CAP.

This project receives funding from the Horizon 2020 Research & Innovation Programme granted by the Bio-based Industries Joint Undertaking.

- Acquire knowledge and develop new technologies in the areas of human and animal health, agriculture and the environment.
- Promote knowledge and technology transfer for the benefit of society.
- Train future generations of researchers and technologists.
- Engage and inform society about advances and the benefits of biotechnology.
