Desde 1896, buscamos mejores formas de prevenir, diagnosticar y tratar enfermedades, contribuyendo con la sociedad en forma sostenible. 

En Roche, estamos comprometidos a mejorar el acceso a innovaciones médicas, a la vez que promovemos un sistema de salud sostenible, trabajando con todos los actores relevantes.

En Sant Cugat, además de la filial española de Diagnostics, en el campus se ubica uno de los principales centros internacionales de innovación y desarrollo del grupo. Equipos multidisciplinares compuestos por personas de más de 30 nacionalidades, integrados en las redes globales de I+D del Grupo, trabajan en el desarrollo de software de automatización, sistema de información y desarrollos digitales relacionados con la salud de las personas.
Location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain

Name: Rovensa Next
Description:
Rovensa Next is the global leader in biosolutions for agriculture, with annual sales exceeding €500 million. The company employs more than 2,200 people worldwide and markets its products in over 90 countries. It brings together a global network of 39 R&D laboratories, excellence centers, fields, and greenhouses, 12 production plants, over 170 partnerships with research centers and universities, 100 R&D and innovation specialists and a dedicated team of more than 850 field experts. 

Rovensa Next markets the broadest biosolutions portfolio in the industry, including biostimulants, biofertilizers, bionutrition, biocontrol (biopesticides and biofungicides), and adjuvants. Rovensa Next, not only develops products, it takes things further by harnessing biosolutions to tacklecurrent real-world challengesthroughintegrated crop strategies. Biosolutions for Rovensa Next representa comprehensive solution, combining biological and natural-based products, innovative technologies, and farming practices, which provide growers with holistic solutions to increase profitability, boost yields and maximize performance.  

Rovensa Next is the result of the integration of twelve pioneering sustainable companies with decades of successful track record in biosolutions: Agrichembio, Agro-K, Agrotecnologia, Cosmocel, Idai Nature, Microquimica, MIP Agro, Oro Agri, OGT, Rodel, SDP, and Tradecorp.  

For more information, please visit us at www.rovensanext.com

Name: Severo Ochoa Molecular Biology Centre (CBM)
Description: The Centro de Biología Molecular Severo Ochoa (CBM) is an experimental research centre in the areas of Molecular, Cellular Biology and Biomedicine. It is a joint centre between the Higher Council for Scientific Research (CSIC) and the Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (UAM).

Name: SEIPASA
Description:
Seipasa is a leading company specialized in natural treatments for agriculture. Seipasa is pioneer in researching, manufacturing and marketing biopesticides, biostimulants and fertilizers.

The company has been working for 20 years in natural protection of crops and plant biostimulation based on solutions of botanical origin. From its headquarters in Valencia, Spain, and conducted by the R&D department, the company formulates and certificates solutions of high technological value which are applied in the most demanding agricultures of the world. Seipasa is stablished in over 20 countries worldwide.

In 2017, Seipasa won the prestigious Agrow Award for the Best Formulation Innovation. Fungisei, the bio-fungicide developed by the company, deserved the award due to the remarkable innovation in their formulation compared to current references in the market.

Name: BTI Biotechnology Institute
Description:
BTI Biotechnology Institute is a Spanish multinational company specialising in biomedicine and biotechnology whose activity focuses on two areas: regenerative medicine and oral implantology. It was founded in 1999 by Dr. Eduardo Anitua, the company’s president and scientific director.

Oral Implantology:
BTI’s implant system is one of the most versatile on the market, an implant system that adapts to the patient, not the other way around, as it offers an extremely wide range of solutions tailored to each need, so that dental professionals can approach their treatments with the utmost confidence and predictability.

Regenerative Medicine:
BTI is a scientific world leader in regenerative medicine as a result of the development and patenting of Plasma Rich in Growth Factors (PRGF — ENDORET) technology and its various applications in multiple fields of medicine such as oral and maxillofacial surgery, trauma, dermatology, rheumatology, ophthalmology, sports medicine and cosmetic medicine.

Research is the DNA of BTI:
BTI is a company highly focused on the research and development of new solutions in the area of biomedicine.
The research carried out has a clear translational component, seeking to apply the knowledge acquired in the laboratory to daily clinical practice, with the aim of improving patient care and quality of life.

Training is one of the cornerstones:
The Postgraduate and Training Centre in Vitoria has become established as a leading international centre for oral implantology and regenerative therapy, which provides training to 2,000 students of various nationalities each year.
The wide range of courses on offer includes our continuous training programmes, specialised courses, residential courses, conferences and symposiums.

Name: AGQ Labs España
Description: AGQ Labs es un grupo tecnológico químico de laboratorios de análisis, ensayos avanzados e ingeniería química especializada. Ofrecemos soluciones y servicios de valor dirigidos a los sectores de la Agricultura, Alimentación, Ciclo del Agua, Industria, Energía, Minería y Farmacéutico. Combinamos tecnología química y analítica con ingeniería química especializada en cada sector.

Name: Biosearch Life, a Kerry Company
Description:
Biosearch Life, a Kerry company is a leading biotechnology company focused on providing innovative solutions for the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical and food industries. Our aim is to make the world a healthier place to live. 

We are continuously committed to innovation by applying science, to improve health and well-being at every life stage. We have a leading portfolio of scientifically proven brands and products that support health. These include:

•	Lipids: Eupoly-3, our branded EPA and DHA-rich ingredients. Due to our proprietary purification process, we have the ability to ultra-purify fish oils, developing highly flexible and stable oils, that can fortify a broad range of food items, with an excellent flavour profile.

•	Natural extracts: Exxentia is our branded botanical extract range. Leveraging our extensive experience in the identification, validation and development of natural extracts, we develop extracts that target specific physiological functions. Our Exxentia  range contains an extensive range of vegetable extract formats for use in pharmaceutical applications (Dry, Fluid, Glycerinated and Soft Extracts).

•	Probiotics: Hereditum our branded premium probiotics range are isolated from human breast milk, which have been clinically proven to activate immune system and improve intestinal well-being.

The pace of scientific development never stands still, and neither do we. We are committed to science-based innovation that supports better health. We partner with our customers on ingredient development, concept design, co-development of final products, scientific data generation and commercialization support.

Biosearch Life, is now part of Kerry. We work together to co-create better tasting, better performing and better-for-you consumer led solutions

Name: Quibim
Description: At Quibim, we design pioneering tools that unlock imaging data to improve patient outcomes. Our main purpose is the application of AI techniques to medical images from MRI, CT, PET to unlock new data which can be transformed into actionable predictions for life sciences and providers.

Name: Certest Biotec, S.L.
Description:
Highly specialized and customer-oriented, Certest Biotec consists of four divisions, including Raw Materials, Immunodiagnostics (Rapid Tests, Turbidimetry, and CLIA), Molecular Biology under the VIASURE brand, and Pharma.

Certest Raw Materials provides high quality solutions for developing and manufacturing your IVD assays. Our expertise in protein expresión & purification, monoclonal antibodies develoment & manufacturing and primers & probes manufacturing offer to our customers a priceless support in their challenging proyects.

Certest Immunodiagnostic -Rapid Test, Turbidimetry, CLIA- is committed to providing a comprehensive portfolio of diagnostic reagents for detecting infectious diseases and different markers, covering different needs of formats, types of use, throughput, precision and time from sample to result.

VIASURE offers a reliable molecular diagnostic solution, from sample to intepretation of results, covering a wide range portfolio of products and enabling laboratories to better inform clinical decissions.

The objective of Certest Pharma is to contribute with its technology to obtain better therapeutic products based on RNA. It is focused on three main áreas: RNAs, Delivery and Vaccines.

Additionally, the expertise of our highly qualified personnel, currently numbering over 300 employees, is at the disposal of our customers, offering development and manufacturing services for the production of their own materials.
Location: San Mateo de Gállego, Aragon, Spain

Name: Werfen Immunoassay
Description:
Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain.

We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant.

We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters are in Barcelona, Spain and our Technology Centers are located in the United States and Europe. Worldwide sales exceeded €2.2 billion in 2024, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Name: Natac (BME: NAT)
Description:
We specialise in producing sustainable natural ingredients with proven health benefits. Our expert team conducts through research and development to deliver high-performance, top-quality solutions across diverse industries. 

Our products are upheld to a level of quality that exceeds the most rigorous standards in the industry. Plant sources are certified additionally through HABOID, a proprietary analytical method, which guarantees the purest botanical products possible.

Sustainability is integral to our business model. Natac systematically analyses agricultural processes throughout the botanical industry to discover points in production that have the potential for intervention and investment. Our goal is to use the whole plant in order to access its full potential and thereby reduce the environmental impact of production.

Internationally present with established markets around the world, Natac maintains the strategic location of our manufacturing, R&D and Innovation Unit, and Quality Department in Spain, which secures European standards.

Name: VIRCELL S.L.
Description: Vircell is a biotechnology company specialized in the development and production of ready-to-use reagents for the diagnosis of infectious diseases in humans by different techniques – ranging from the traditional cell culture to the most innovating developments in the field of molecular biology-.

Name: Instituto de Biología Molecular y Celular de Plantas, IBMCP (UPV - CSIC)
Description:
- Investigación científica encaminada a la obtención de plantas con una mejor productividad, calidad del fruto o con propiedades de alto valor añadido (de interés para el consumidor, los agricultores y la industria agroalimentaria) y más resistentes al estrés, así como menos dependientes de los tratamientos químicos, para así contribuir a una agricultura menos agresiva con el entorno.

- Servicios avanzados de Genómica, Proteómica, Metabolómica, Bioinformática, Microscopía, Cuantiicación de Hormonas Vegetales, Secuenciación de DNA y Análisis de Expresión Génica.

- Formación de personal investigador.

Name: Fujirebio
Description:
Fujirebio is a world leading in vitro diagnostics (IVD) company and innovation-driven content provider, enabling breakthrough diagnostic solutions to reach patients worldwide through science, partnership, and proven global impact.

Founded in Tokyo in 1950, Fujirebio has spent more than 75 years developing pioneering biomarkers and diagnostic technologies across oncology, infectious diseases, and neurological disorders. Today, our technology plays a vital role in many of the world’s most trusted IVD tests – often reaching patients through partnerships with leading diagnostic companies operating across multiple platforms.

Our open business model is built on a virtuous circle: we invest more than 15% of our base revenue in R&D to develop novel diagnostic content; we prove its value through real-world validation on our own Lumipulse platform and through our connection with SRL, one of the world’s largest clinical laboratories; and we share proven solutions globally through our Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services. Revenues from these partnerships are reinvested to fuel further innovation.

We are particularly active in neurological diagnostics. Our FDA-cleared Lumipulse G pTau 217/β-Amyloid 1-42 Plasma Ratio test represents a significant advance in accessible blood-based Alzheimer’s disease diagnostics, and our 2022 acquisition of ADx NeuroSciences further strengthened our neurological biomarker pipeline.

Fujirebio is a consolidated subsidiary of H.U. Group Holdings, Inc. (Tokyo Stock Exchange: TYO 4544), employing more than 1,200 people across Japan, Europe, and the Americas.

Name: Viralgen
Description:
Viralgen Vector Core becomes the convergence point from experienced specialized organizations in biotechnology and life science fields, united with the aim of creating a CDMO in the sector of gene therapy and innovative medicines. Developing and manufacturing in order to contribute to the progress in health and welfare of people.

Viralgen Vector Core is a partnership uniquely positioned in the CDMO industry to bring forward a robust suspension platform for AAV production in a facility custom-designed to bring therapies to market as quickly as possible. Leveraging the technology platforms of Askbio, Viralgen is able to support every aspect of your AAV program from start to finish, including large-scale manufacturing, fill-finish, and quality control in a GMP-certified environment in San Sebastian, Spain

Name: FUTURECO BIOSCIENCE
Description: FUTURECO BIOSCIENCE is a Spanish agrobiotechnology company based in Barcelona, dedicated to research, development, manufacturing and worldwide commercialization of effective products for the protection and nutrition of agricultural crops environmentally friendly. The mission of the company is to continue leading the industry by providing clean solutions for the challenges of the new agriculture, and to promote the use of practices and products aimed to minimize the environmental impact of this activity.

Name: Bitbrain
Description:
Bitbrain was founded in 2010 as a spin-off company of a research team  from the University of Zaragoza, pioneer in approaching brain-computer  interface applications outside laboratory investigation settings. 
Its DNA holds all knowledge in neurotechnology, biomedical engineering, artificial intelligence and data science accumulated at the university  since 1998. 
Nowadays, the R+D+I bet is still strong, which has converted the company in a world reference for B2B neurotechnology solutions.

Name: BTSA
Description:
BTSA is a global company with headquarters in Spain, subsidiary in the United States.

With more than 30 years of experience we are one of the leading European manufacturers of Natural Antioxidants and Natural Vitamin E for food, nutraceutical, cosmetics & personal care, and animal nutrition, since 1994.

Our customers from more than 40 countries rely on our products and services, which have been developed by our highly qualified team of experts. 

BTSA’s commitment to the highest quality standards is guaranteed by the main international certificates.

For more information, please visit www.btsa.com/en.
Location: Alcalá de Henares, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: Koppert España
Description:
Desde su creación en 1.994, Koppert España contribuye a la mejora de la salud de las personas y a la implantación de métodos sostenibles de producción de alimentos. Colaboramos con la naturaleza para lograr que la agricultura española sea más sana, segura, productiva y respetuosa con el entorno. 

Ofrecemos un sistema integrado de conocimientos expertos y de soluciones naturales y seguras que mejoran la salud, resistencia y producción del cultivo, tanto en producciones de invernadero como al aire libre. Somos expertos en la producción de enemigos naturales para la agricultura y colmenas para polinización natural. Apostamos por la innovación continua mediante programas propios de investigación y colaboramos con equipos de investigadores públicos y privados de prestigiosas instituciones y universidades.

Nuestra matriz es Koppert Biological Systems, creada en Holanda en 1967. Koppert es miembro de IBMA, la asociación mundial de industrias de biocontrol que produce microorganismos, macroorganismos, semioquímicos y pesticidas naturales para la protección de plantas y la salud pública.

www.koppert.es

www.partnerswithnature.org

Name: Veritas Genetics
Description:
At Veritas, we apply science and our global resources to bring genetic and genomic diagnostics to people to extend and significantly improve their lives. Our global portfolio includes preventive medicine, perinatal medicine, and genomic diagnostic services.

In March 2022 Veritas announced that it was becoming part of LetsGetChecked, a global healthcare solutions company based in Dublin and New York.

In keeping with our responsibility as a leading biotechnology company, we collaborate with healthcare providers, governments, and local communities to support and expand access to genetic and genomic medicine reliably and affordably around the world.

Name: AgriTecno | Ajinomoto Group
Description:
At AgriTecno, we drive sustainable agriculture forward with advanced biostimulants and plant nutrition solutions.

Backed by over 20 years of expertise and part of the Ajinomoto Group, we combine science, technology, and agronomic knowledge to help farmers boost crop health, resilience, and productivity.

Our global presence and deep commitment to sustainability enable us to create efficient, environmentally friendly solutions tailored to different crops and regions.

 Innovation & Science: We develop solutions rooted in biotechnology, optimizing nutrient absorption and crop resilience.

 Sustainable Impact: Our products support sustainable farming, reducing environmental impact while enhancing yields.

 Global Network, Local Approach: With a presence in multiple markets, we empower growers worldwide with cutting-edge tools and personalized support.

 Join us in shaping the future of agriculture.

Name: Biorce
Description:
Our mission is to dramatically reduce the time and cost of clinical trials. Aika, our AI platform, supports the various stages of the clinical trial lifecycle Phase 1-3, up until market approval. 

Clinical trials can take 11 years and cost ∼$6.2B to bring a drug to market. 
57% face costly protocol amendments that add months of delay.

We're changing that.

With Aika, users can generate compliant and comprehensive documents (feasibility studies, entire protocols, application forms, financial documents, consent forms etc.) within minutes. 

Aika features nearly 100% of clinical trials published in the past 25 years (1M+ trials from official registries), 260K+ clinical trial protocols, peer-reviewed articles, regulatory guidelines and many more. 

Every recommendation is backed by verifiable sources. Every decision stays with the clinical experts. Human oversight guaranteed. 

Faster trials don’t mean more risk. With Aika, they mean smarter science. 

The impact:
→ 50% faster protocol development
→ $200K-$400K saved per avoided amendment
→ Regulatory-ready outputs from day one

Built by clinical experts, for clinical experts.

Name: Symborg España y Portugal
Description:
Symborg is leader in agricultural biotechnology research development and innovation. The company helps growers to maximize crops yield while overcoming the challenge of sustainability, providing them with innovative biological solutions.

Focusing on developing patented technology, Symborg shares its expertise at an international level: today, the company has subsidiaries in Europe, USA, South America, Asia and its products are used in over 40 countries.

A committed player in biotechnology applied to agriculture.

Symborg contributes daily to the promotion of mycorrhizal research and developments throughout the world as member of the IMS International Mycorrhiza Society. The company also participates actively in promoting the concept of biological control methods in sustainable agriculture and increase the awareness of biopesticides as effective products, and realizes improvements to the regulatory process around the world.

Name: Ziacom Group
Description:
Diseñadores y fabricantes de soluciones innovadoras de #implantes para el bienestar de tu paciente.

En Ziacom llevamos más de 20 años trabajando por la salud bucodental y el bienestar de pacientes en todo el mundo a través del diseño y fabricación de soluciones innovadoras en implantes dentales, componentes protésicos, instrumental quirúrgico y biomateriales de máxima calidad.

Name: CIC bioGUNE
Description: CIC bioGUNE (Center for Cooperative Research in Biosciences), part of the Basque Research and Technology Alliance (BRTA), is a non-profit  is a leading Spanish research institution advancing Precision Medicine through multidisciplinary research in Life Sciences. Based in the Bizkaia Science and Technology Park, it hosts over 200 scientists across 19 research groups, driving innovation in molecular mechanisms of disease. With cutting-edge infrastructure, including a unique NMR facility, and a strong track record in high-impact research, patents, and collaborations, CIC bioGUNE is recognized globally for scientific excellence and technological innovation.

Name: ProGnosis Biotech
Description:
At ProGnosis Biotech, we're not just advancing diagnostics, we're shaping a sustainable and safer tomorrow. Headquartered in Larissa, Greece, with a strong presence through subsidiaries in 10 countries, we are a globally recognized, export-driven enterprise. Utilizing state-of-the-art ELISA and Lateral Flow technologies, we deliver unmatched precision and reliability in food safety, clinical, and veterinary diagnostics. By integrating real-time data sharing through mobile applications with GPS connectivity, we empower stakeholders to make informed decisions instantly, enhancing transparency and safety across the entire supply chain. Since 2011, our commitment to innovative and eco-friendly solutions has empowered industries and protected lives in over 80 countries worldwide.

What Sets Us Apart?
 Global Recognition by Renowned Institutions: ILVO, AOAC, USDA, LILC, PIWET, ensuring the highest quality and reliability of our products.
 Innovative Technology: From proprietary antibodies to cloud-connected mobile apps, we revolutionize diagnostics with real-time data sharing and GPS-enabled insights, boosting transparency and efficiency.
 Total Quality Commitment: Guided by ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and ISO 37001 certifications, we uphold the strictest quality standards across all processes.
 Dedicated Customer Support: Our diagnostic tools come with hands-on training and continuous support, ensuring seamless integration into your operations.
 Custom Business Solutions: We collaborate to develop precise diagnostics that fit your specific needs.
 Sustainability in Focus: Designing diagnostic tools that not only perform exceptionally but also minimize environmental impact.

ProGnosis Biotech: Accuracy through innovation
Building trust across the supply chain together – from field to shelf.

Name: JUNO Genetics EU
Description:
UK-USA-Spain-Italy
Juno Genetics is a state-of-the-art laboratory specialising in genetic testing. Our mission is to provide clinically useful information of the highest quality for couples who are planning to start a family, patients undergoing fertility treatments, and for women who are already pregnant. The innovative tests offered by Juno Genetics are amongst the most technologically advanced and accurate available anywhere in the world. 

Preimplantation Genetic Diagnosis (PGD), Preimplantation Genetic Screening (PGT-A), Products of Conception (POC), Carrier Genetic,...
  
Juno offers the most accurate and advanced tests currently available. 

The cutting-edge tests provided by Juno are the result of world-class research carried out by an internationally renowned team of scientists. 

Juno consistently achieves the best results in the field thanks to our commitment to:
 
- Utilisation of the most advanced technology, enabling high-accuracy analysis of the broadest range of genetic abnormalities during all stages of a fertility treatment.
-             Research and development, with more than 30 years of research carried out and more than 350 scientific publications, and 3 research centers.
- Establishing the most robust processes for ensuring delivery of the highest quality of genetic tests.
 
Our dedicated team of professionals headed by Professor Dagan Wells, has developed unique algorithms, techniques and processes, with the aim of increasing the chances for a healthy pregnancy following assisted reproduction treatment.

Juno Your partners in genetic health

Name: FEBiotec, Federación Española de Biotecnólogos
Description:
FEBiotec, Federación Española de Biotecnólogos, se funda el 2008 para crear un nuevo marco común de actuación a lo largo de España para los profesionales en biotecnología. 

FEBiotec pretende regular la actividad profesional de biotecnólogo,  mantener la excelencia de su formación,  promover y defender su figura profesional. Para ello representa de manera unitaria  a todos los profesionales presentes y futuros en biotecnología en España. 

Además, FEBiotec realiza una importante labor de networking en el sector y de difusión de la cultura científica a la sociedad. 

Actualmente FEBiotec está conformada por 11 Asociaciones Miembro, la Junta Directiva y Voluntarios que trabajan en los diferentes departamentos o comisiones de trabajo.

Name: Amgen España
Description:
Somos una de las mayores compañías de biotecnología del mundo. En nuestras cuatro décadas de historia, hemos contribuido a construir los fundamentos de la industria biomédica actual y seguimos arrancando cada día con el deseo de seguir aportando para que todos vivamos más y mejor. 

Desde nuestro nacimiento, tenemos un claro propósito: descubrir, diseñar y desarrollar tratamientos innovadores para mejorar la salud la vida de las personas que padecen patologías graves en las en las áreas de oncología, hematología, nefrología así como en las enfermedades cardiovasculares, óseas e inflamatorias. En esa lucha incansable utilizamos nuestro amplio conocimiento en biología, ingeniería molecular y genética, así como la tecnología más puntera en biomedicina.

Iniciamos nuestra andadura en Thousand Oaks (California, Estados Unidos) en 1980. Lo que en sus inicios fue una start up, hoy en día es una compañía con más de 27.000 empleados en todo el mundo y presencia en más de 100 países. En España, contamos con más de 330 profesionales que desarrollan su labor siempre en equipo y con pasión.
 
Creemos firmemente en que nuestra labor debe ir más allá del desarrollo y producción de fármacos. Por eso, también aportamos nuestro granito de arena para hacer que la sociedad sea más justa e igualitaria e impulsamos la educación científica a través de varios programas  tanto para estudiantes de bachillerato como universitarios.

Puedes conocer nuestra política  de privacidad aquí: https://www.amgen.es/politica-de-privacidad y nuestra política sobre redes sociales aquí: https://www.amgen.es/politica-redes-sociales

Name: Medcom Tech
Description: Medcomtech SA is a Spain-based company primarily engaged in the distribution and wholesale of innovative and technologically advanced products in the areas of orthopedics, traumatology, neurosurgery and anesthesiology in Spain and Portugal.

Name: LIDA Plant Research
Description:
Lida Plant Research is a plant-biotechnology company specializing in new biostimulants and plant vaccines solutions that enhance plant resistance against biotic and abiotic stress, thereby increasing crop yields and bringing added value to growers and consumers.

Our scientific know-how has been developed over 25 years of research and uses the latest technology to learn about plant behavior  in environment that surrounds.

Lida Plant Research supports the generation of scientific knowledge and its transfer to the market with the clear objective to contribute to a more sustainable and efficient agriculture that meets current and future needs.

Our primary mission is to create new solutions in the laboratory and then to transfer and adapt them so they can be used in the field, from the scientist to farmer.

Solutions for a new agriculture:
Products to increase plant immunology.
Products to enhance plant resistance against abiotic stress.
Products to improve the quality of fruit.
High performance nutrients.
Products for best rooting development.
High quality fruit programmes.

Our mission: a sustainable agriculture
In Lida Plant Research, we are used to work with the highest quality standards, meeting the requirements and needs of the whole value chain and bringing to the final consumer quality fruits without residues.

Name: Agomab
Description: Agomab is translating a deep expertise in growth factor biology to pioneer and develop novel treatments that aim to resolve fibrosis, repair tissue structure and restore organ function. Combining new scientific insights with robust drug development and a long-term corporate vision, we are building a broad clinical pipeline of differentiated programs with disease modifying potential in severe organ failure and fibrotic diseases.

Name: REGEMAT 3D
Description:
REGEMAT3D develops customized Bioprinting Systems and Bioreactors - BMAP. We create Living Tissue Technologies.

The potential of bioprinting in regenerative medicine and tissue engineering is huge. There are still many problems to be solved and many hypothesis to be tested in order to find solutions to tissue regeneration.

Our mission is to develop innovative solutions in the area of bioprinting and regenerative medicine towards the clinical application of this amazing technology, to improve people ́s quality of life.

Name: ONA Therapeutics
Description: Ona Therapeutics is pioneering the development of first-in-class antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) that exploit the molecular underpinnings of advanced cancer. We partner with renowned academics and clinicians to discover novel therapeutic targets from the unique biology of treatment refractory advanced cancer patients. Our approach combines privileged biology with Ona’s expertise in biologics. Together, we craft ADCs and antibody therapies, aiming to provide effective new treatments for patients with no remaining alternatives.

Name: Sistemas Genómicos | Eurofins
Description:
En Sistemas Genómicos estamos comprometidos con mejorar la calidad de vida de los pacientes y sus familias. Por ello, diseñamos herramientas de calidad para el diagnóstico, combinando la tecnología más avanzada con la última investigación científica. 

Somos pioneros en la aplicación de la tecnología de secuenciación masiva (NGS) para el Diagnóstico Genético, como así también somos la organización con mayor trayectoria a nivel Nacional e Internacional en Investigación y Desarrollo de Servicios de Diagnóstico Genético basado en nuestra amplia experiencia en el estudio del genoma y de la genética humana.

Name: DECCO Postharvest
Description: DECCO is the global leader in providing postharvest solutions to reduce food waste and enhance the freshness of fresh fruits and vegetables. We provide solutions all along the food supply chain from harvest to the table. DECCO delivers value every day to packers, shippers, supermarkets and consumers with customized coatings, decay control, sanitization and disinfection products, application technology, on-site service and 90+ years of postharvest expertise.  Our 200+ dedicated DECCO employees operate in over 40 countries.   For more information please visit deccopostharvest.com

Name: Tebrio
Description:
Tebrio is a Spanish biotechnology company that is building an 90.000 square meter insect farm – the largest of its kind in the world, which, in line with our pilot operations, will breed and transform mealworms into 3 main co-products: (i) amino rich, sustainable premium protein for petfood, fishmeal and animal feed, (ii) tech powered biofertilizer for plant nutrition and (iii) chitosan for bioindustrial uses. Our carbon-negative, zero residue operations do not emit greenhouse gases like ammonia or methane; we use 98% less water and 90% less arable land than plant protein and livestock farms, and our new farm has the capacity of producing 100.000 tons of co-products a year, making it a resource-efficient answer to regional food security.  
 
Our commercial products are:
1. oProtein: for Pet Food, Fishmeal and Animal Feed
2. oFrass: organic fertilizers 
3. oTosan: for all types of industrial uses, agronomics, health market, bio plastics and so on...
4. oLipids

----

Tebrio, anteriormente conocido como MealFood Europe, es una de las empresas pioneras en la cría de insectos (Tenebrio Molitor) industrial en Europa. Trabajamos con tecnología propia, utilizando las técnicas más novedosas, lo que nos posiciona como una de las empresas líderes en el sector.

Gracias a nuestra tecnología y Know-how, podemos comercializar los productos con mayor valor añadido del mercado, así como atender a la gran demanda de producto de nuestros clientes y garantizando la inocuidad de nuestros productos.

Nuestros productos comerciales son:
1. oProtein, utilizado en los mercados de Alimentación Animal y PetFood.
2. oFrass, línea de fertilizantes orgánicos.
3. oTosan: para todo tipo de usos industriales, cosméticos, agrícolas, bioplásticos, biosanitarios, etc...
4. oLipids, grasa insaturada de primera calidad para alimentación animal.
Location: Doñinos de Salamanca, Castilla and Leon, Spain

Name: Vytrus Biotech
Description: We create natural active ingredients for skincare and haircare through innovative and sustainable biotechnology processes which obtain the real power of plants.

Description: The first research centre specialising in immunology in Spain

Name: B'ZEOS
Description:
B'ZEOS is a green-tech company that develops novel bio-based packaging solutions. 

We believe in the power of biotechnology in solving the plastic waste challenge and want to bring about meaningful and lasting change to our environment. Our regenerative materials replace the need for single-use plastic.

Currently we are working on developing sustainable products based on seaweed, which can replace disposable plastic articles in the food service industry.

We are constantly involved in research and material formulation development to offer the best products in the market.

Name: 3D Biotechnology Solutions - 3DBS
Description:
3D Biotechnology Solutions - 3DBS is a Brazilian biotech startup developing 3D BIOPRINTED in vitro models, such as skin, intestinal barrier and liver spheroids. We also customize bioprinters and electrospinning machine as a platform for any application. Specialized in miomimetics, 3D bioprinting and electrospinning technologies, the company has established strategic cooperation with São Leopoldo Mandic School, CNPEM, UNIFESP Medical School at São Paulo, EMBRAPA in Brasilia, FAPESP, UNICAMP. Our products have been used in cosmetic and pharmaceutical industries, public and private Research Institutes and universities. 

A 3D Biotechnology Solutions – 3DBS é uma startup de base tecnológica, fundada em 2017, especializada no campo da biofabricação de tecidos humanos utilizando tecnologias proprietárias de bioimpressão 3D e eletrofiação. Fornecemos modelos in vitro de pele, barreira intestinal e fígado, além de equipamentos customizados de bioimpressão 3D e electrospinning.  Nosso objetivo atual é possibilitar a redução do uso de cobaias animais,  atendendo as indústrias cosméticas e farmacológicas, para no futuro fornecer tecidos humanos vivos que comprovadamente funcionem como tecidos nativos.

Name: Bioo
Description:
From living biological batteries below earth that generate energy, save water and compensate heat; to bioluminescent plants, able to reduce energy use and light pollution; and even biological activators, using leaves to create automations between the human beings and plants, are some of the unique biotechnologies developed in our labs. 

Bioo is ideating, installing and developing buildings and parks around the planet by becoming its biotech partner, not only incorporating the first system in the world that recovers the economical investment of its green areas, but also providing a real symbiosis between nature and technology while absorbing CO2. All, without damaging any living being in the process, and enhancing our natural ecosystems. 

We move towards the next biotech revolution.

Name: Baïa Food
Description: Baïa es una marca de suplementación natural con base científica que nace de una experiencia vital real y de una convicción clara: cuidar la salud debería ser fácil, placentero y compatible con la vida real.

Name: AB-BIOTICS
Description: AB-BIOTICS is a leading probiotics player inspired by developing probiotic solutions at the forefront of an expanding field. Whether you are interested in unique, patented strains with characterized mechanisms of action, premium probiotic solutions targeting specific therapeutic areas, or finished products with easily-communicated benefits, our agile approach allows us to adapt to your needs. With science at the heart of everything we do, our strains, blends and market-ready products are supported by robust scientific documentation. Our global footprint gives us a unique view of the ever-changing probiotic landscape enabling us to offer regulatory support in not only supplements, and functional foods but also OTC and medical applications to meet the needs of consumers worldwide.
Location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain

Name: Royal Queen Seeds
Description:
Established in 2007 in Amsterdam, Royal Queen Seeds (RQS) is the market leader at the forefront of the global cannabis genetics industry, recently recognized as “Best Seedbank of the Year” at The International Cannabis Awards.

Driven by an inherent passion for the plant, RQS meticulously tests each seed for germination, vigor, yield and both recreational and medical efficacy. This dedication, combined with relentless research and development, allows RQS to pioneer and anticipate market trends while delivering top-tier genetics curated by its team of biologists.

The company is also a respected cannabis educator that offers comprehensive grow guides, resources and instruction for cultivators. It has developed an extensive range of modern genetics—including autoflowering and proprietary F1 hybrids—that cater to the varied needs of contemporary growers at every skill level, from hobbyists to professionals.

Multiple Cannabis Cup victories and prestigious "Best Seed Bank'' awards speak to the company’s outstanding breeding and innovation. RQS operates online in the U.S. and 28 countries across Europe. Headquartered in Barcelona, brick and mortar locations can be found in Amsterdam and South Africa. Learn more at royalqueenseeds.com.

Let's #GrowHigher together!

Name: Agrobio SL
Description:
Agrobío is a bio-factory that produces beneficial insects for pest control and bumblebees for natural pollination.

Founded in 1995 in Almería, Agrobío has been pioneer in producing bumblebees in Spain. Thanks to its trajectory and location in the heart of crops under plastic, Agrobío has become a model for Mediterranean agriculture.

We work to accomplish the residue 0 and restore the natural balance, helping growers to obtain a healthy and safe produce of the highest quality.

Name: Hifas da Terra S.L.
Description:
Hifas da Terra is the first biotechnology company which covers the mycological universe. It offers the widest selection of organic products from a natural resource: mushrooms.

Species as Shiitake (Lentinula edodes), Oyster mushroom (Pleurotus ostreatus) or King trumpet mushroom (Pleurotus ostreatus) grow on organic substrates such as wood. This way, we obtain first quality products which grow under a 30 year old chestnut forest.

We integrate innovation and ecology in each of the processes which we perform for obtaining mushroom products free of pesticides and heavy metals. Growing higher quality mushrooms we get the best products concentrating essential amino acids, polysaccharides, proteins, minerals, vitamins and a variety of enzymes which help us take care of our health.

MICOLOGY APPLIED TO FOOD, HEALTH AND ENVIRONMENT:

GOURMET: Gourmet vegan food
MICOSALUD: Super food, food supplements and pet supplements
MICOSALUD DERMOCOSMETICS: serums, soaps and massage candles
MICOGARDEN: mushroom growing products and mycorrhized trees

GREEN PHILOSOPHY
We select the best strains and cultivate fungi associated with tree roots for obtaining superior trees, of higher production and growth which are resistant to common plant diseases. 

Our work is integrated in the environment to be respectful with each new project we undertake. We recycle 90% of waste materials we produce, reusing forest residues to feed our biomass heating system and, moreover, we collect rainwater in one well adapted to the ozonization of water.

Mushroom growing is carried out in an area of 120.000 square meters. Thanks to our constant innovation we employ our mushrooms to develop new foods and dermocosmetical products from mushrooms which meet the highest quality standards: organic and natural.

In addition, our forest brings oxygen and helps maintain the health of Galician forests betting on the recovery of native species such as the chestnut tree.

Name: ARTHEx Biotech
Description:
ARTHEx Biotech is a spin-off biotech company from the University of Valencia (Spain) focused on the research and development of novel oligonucleotide therapies that modulate microRNA to treat diseases with unmet medical needs. 
 
ARTHEx has developed its proprietary platform that allows fast and flexible development of investigational miR-modulating oligonucleotides that are designed to enter relevant tissues in pharmacological quantities, in order to treat diseases in which microRNAs play a key role.

The first investigational product from this platform is ATX-01, an antimiR in  development for Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 (DM1). DM1 is an orphan disease affecting more than 900,000 people worldwide (estimated prevalence 1/8,000) with no cure, nor approved treatment to date. ATX-01 is a first-in-class disease-modifying therapy that addresses the cause of DM1 with a dual and unique mechanism of action, which targets micro-RNA-23b a key factor in the disease pathogenesis.

To learn more about Arthex Biotech, please visit us at  www.arthexbiotech.com

Name: TRICHODEX
Description: Empresa dedicada a la investigación y producción de soluciones biotecnológicas para uso en la agricultura.

Name: MAFA Bioscience
Description: MAFA is specialized in research, development, formulation, production, and commercialization of products with Low Environmental Impact for crops nutrition and protection. MAFA provides efficient and natural solutions without residues for sustainable agriculture.

Name: ZeClinics
Description:
ZeClinics is a leading zebrafish-expert CRO, dedicated to tailoring innovative solutions for understanding human disease and advancing drug and target discovery. Our mission is to accelerate research by providing deep in vivo insights, enabling reliable safety and efficacy assessments of new drugs and chemical compounds to reach the market faster. We challenge the traditional discovery process by integrating our expertise in zebrafish biology with cutting-edge lab automation and artificial intelligence.

As specialists in CRISPR genome editing, ZeClinics creates custom genome-edited zebrafish models to accurately mimic human diseases. This approach allows us to evaluate the biomedical relevance of candidate compounds and genes in vivo. Our unique zebrafish platforms bridge the gap between cell cultures and mammalian models, offering faster, cost-effective investigations that emphasize proof-of-principle experiments for rapid go/no-go decision making, thereby accelerating the early-stage development of new compounds.

ZeClinics offers essential services to pharmaceutical, biotech, nutraceutical, and agrochemical companies, as well as academic research institutions worldwide, helping to enhance and expedite their R&D efforts.
Location: Sant Feliu de Llobregat, Catalonia, Spain

Name: ValGenetics
Description:
Empresa biotecnológica de I+D+i que ofrece soluciones científicas adaptadas al sector agrario y agroalimentario. Los servicios que presta están enfocados a mejorar la productividad y calidad de los cultivos, a través de la patología de plantas, genética vegetal y microbiana, cultivo in vitro, fisiología vegetal, servicios de bioinformática, bioensayos y proyectos de I+D+i. 

Su objetivo es poner la ciencia al servicio de la agricultura, para ello cuenta con una plantilla de científicos especialistas en vida vegetal y laboratorios autorizados que cumplen con las regulaciones internacionales.

Name: Neoalgae
Description: Empresa de base biotecnológica dedicada a la producción, asesoramiento científico-técnico del cultivo de microalgas así como la puesta en marcha de fotobiorreactores con fines alimenticios, energéticos (biocombustibles), farmacéuticos-cosméticos, captura y fijación de CO2, depuración de aguas residuales, etc.

Name: CapGen Seeds
Description:
Capital Genetic es una compañía dedicada a la mejora genética de las principales especies hortícolas  y a la producción y comercialización de semillas de calidad.

La semilla desempeña un papel fundamental en la producción agrícola , es el principio de la vida  y tiene una gran repercusión en los rendimientos y calidad de la cosecha. Para atender las nuevas demandas y necesidades del mercado CAPITAL GENETIC desarrolla programas de mejora genética convencional, asistida por innovadores procesos y métodos biotecnológicos.

En Capital Genetic queremos llevar el mejor producto al campo y al consumidor;  para ello investigamos con el fin de incrementar  la  productividad, la adaptabilidad, la calidad de fruto, y para incorporar resistencias a enfermedades que contribuyen de forma notoria al control de sanidad de cultivos.

Nuestro trabajo se rige por los  principios de calidad, servicio, gestión responsable y compromiso con nuestro entorno medioambiental y social.

Name: 53Biologics
Description:
53Biologics is an end-to-end CDMO for your preclinical and clinical projects, with extensive experience in decoding biologics production (plasmid DNA and recombinant proteins) providing services of cell line generation, banking and characterization, analytical development, process development (USP & DSP) and batches production of both Drug Substances and Drug Products.

Our mission is to provide services to different companies, from start-ups to large companies, as well as to other CDMOs, to help their products to reach the market. 53Biologics works in a quick, proactive and efficient way, always ensuring very high-quality standards.

Name: Pig Improvement Company (PIC) - Europe
Description:
Welcome to the Pig Improvement Company’s (PIC) – Europe LinkedIn account. 

Here at PIC, our goal is to help our customers be the most successful pork producers in the world. You may know us for our tagline of “Never stop improving.” That’s been our story for nearly 60 years, because success in pigs starts with high quality pig genetics. 

From replacement gilts to replacement boars and boar semen, pig producers trust us for proven, productive and ROI-driven pig genetics. At PIC, we select for commercially-relevant traits that create the foundation for profitable production. 

In addition to our industry-leading pig genetics, you may know us for our experienced team of experts. We are leaders in pig genetic improvement and are trusted globally with operations in over 40 countries. Count on us to bring you the latest innovations to drive genetic improvement, a global bio-secure supply system to deliver world-renowned genetics, and on-farm experts to help you realize the full value of PIC genetics. 

PIC is the pig division of Genus plc, a genetics leader with the mission to pioneer animal genetic improvement to help nourish the world. Genus strives to provide beef, dairy and pork producers with superior breeding stock to enable the production of affordable and nutritious animal protein for consumers.
Location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain

Name: SYLENTIS
Description:
Sylentis is an European biotechnological company founded in 2006. Sylentis focuses on researching new therapeutic approaches based on gene silencing. Our company is specialised in developing ophtalmologic   therapies via interference RNA, a powerful tool for rational drug design.

Most advanced product of the company are treatments for glaucoma and dry eye syndrome.

Sylentis is a wholly owned member of PharmaMar (www.pharmamar.com)
Location: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: BASQUE HEALTH CLUSTER
Description:
Our journey began with a clear mission: to advance and promote the biosciences and health sector in the Basque Country. Ten years later, we have grown into a dynamic cluster that collaborates closely with our partners, encompassing up to 75% of the region's bioscience landscape. By engaging with public administrations and fostering partnerships with both national and international clusters and organizations, we are dedicated to enhancing the competitiveness and innovation of our members. Together, we are shaping a healthier future.
***
Nacimos con el objetivo de mejorar y promover el sector de las biociencias y la salud en Euskadi. 10 años después, somos un clúster cercano a nuestros socios, que agrupa hasta el 75% del sector vasco. Colaboramos con las administraciones públicas, así como otros clústeres y organizaciones nacionales e internacionales para impulsar la competitividad de nuestras entidades asociadas.

Name: TECNIC Bioprocess Solutions
Description:
We develop and manufacture scalable bioprocess technologies for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries, supporting both Multi-Use and Single-Use strategies. Our portfolio includes bioreactors, tangential flow filtration (TFF) systems, software for process control and monitoring, cell and gene therapy platforms, modular systems, and single-use consumables such as bags and flowkits.

Our solutions are designed to facilitate efficient scale-up from laboratory to pilot and commercial production, ensuring robust performance, automation, and adaptability across a wide range of applications from monoclonal antibodies and vaccines to cell therapies, recombinant proteins, enzymes, microbial fermentation, and more.

Name: Centro de Investigaciones Biológicas Margarita Salas (CSIC)
Description:
The Margarita Salas Center for Biological Research (CIB-CSIC) founded in 1953 by the Spanish National Research Council stands out at the forefront of biology playing an outstanding role in the establishment and development of molecular biology in Spain since the 20th century.
Today, the CIB fosters high-quality research and training, providing knowledge-based solutions to societal challenges such as global health, quality of life (biomedicine), and environmental biotechnology (circular economy).

Name: Zymvol Biomodeling
Description:
Almost any industry can implement clean, sustainable and efficient processes using biocatalysts.

It's just a matter of making these solutions accessible to everyone.

 At Zymvol, we’re on a mission to develop custom-made enzymes for any industry; turning green chemistry into the go-to option for companies worldwide.

By combining physics-based simulations, AI, and real-world industrial data, Zymvol designs scale-ready enzymes faster, cheaper, and with higher predictability than traditional approaches.

Get to know us better at:
→ www.zymvol.com

Or grab a coffee  with us:
→ info@zymvol.com
.
.
.
For more information about our Social Media Data Policy, please visit https://zymvol.com/privacy-policy/

Name: VEGANIC
Description: Inspirados en la naturaleza, diseñamos productos bioestimulantes y fitosanitarios naturales 100% orgánicos y veganos, sin crueldad animal, para producciones respetuosas con el medio ambiente y sin residuos fitosanitarios.
Location: Pobla De Vallbona , Valencian Community, Spain

Name: INNEA Biotechnology
Description:
INNEA Biotechnology drives agricultural, forestry, and biotechnological innovation through advanced techniques in plant micropropagation, tissue culture, genetic improvement, molecular biology, applied mycology, and regenerative agriculture. Founded in 2008, our company leverages cutting-edge biotechnology to deliver high-quality plants, customized solutions, and sustainable projects to farmers, foresters, and the biotechnology industry.

Our highly specialized R&D team ensures excellence through techniques such as in vitro culture, somatic embryogenesis, molecular breeding, germplasm conservation, the development of fungal inoculants, and innovation projects in agroforestry and soil regeneration.

We are committed to driving sustainable growth, enhancing agricultural productivity, and contributing to a more resilient and greener future.

Partner with us to transform the future of agriculture and biotechnology.

Micropropagation | Tissue Culture | Genetic Improvement | Molecular Biology | Applied Mycology | Regenerative Agriculture

www.innea.org

Name: Omniscope
Description:
Building the world's largest immune databank to inform therapy and develop diagnostics through a convergence of high-resolution immune cell sequencing and artificial intelligence. 

We bring together bright minds from multiple disciplines. We are driven to shorten the timeline from research to real-world human impact. Our motivation is to put science in service of humanity.

Join us in our mission: Healthcare for everyone, everywhere.

Science is we all.

Name: VIVOLABS
Description: VIVO Laboratorio is a national and international leader in molecular genetics, specializing in predictive medicine, diagnosis of rare diseases, nutrigenetics, celiac disease or pharmacogenetics. More than 1,000 tests are offered in our catalog for supporting of all medical specialties: neurology, oncology, gynecology, endocrinology, digestive, pediatrics, allergology and more. Based in Alcobendas (Madrid, Spain), we have 20 years of experience and the best certifications. At our school, VIVO Campus, we offer specialized university training in genetics, with theoretical and practical courses on molecular biology techniques aimed at professionals in different fields of clinical genetics.

Name: APICES CRO
Description:
APICES is a full-service European Contract Research Organization specializing in clinical trials and real-world evidence research. With offices in Spain and France (formerly Kappa Santé), coverage across all major EU-5 markets and beyond, we combine scientific excellence with operational agility to accelerate high-quality clinical development.

Founded in 2009 by experienced professionals from the pharmaceutical and CRO industries, APICES provides comprehensive services across Phases 0–IV and post-authorization studies. Our 100+ experts deliver integrated solutions in regulatory affairs, project management, clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, medical writing, safety, and pharmacoepidemiology.

We have successfully conducted more than 450 clinical projects, partnering with 5,000+ investigators and enrolling over 100,000 patients. Our teams are recognized for strong expertise in oncology and hematology, as well as in cardiometabolic diseases, immunology, respiratory diseases, vaccines, rare diseases, and public health.

APICES combines the scientific rigor and reliability of large organizations with the responsiveness, flexibility, and personalized approach of a mid-sized CRO. We design efficient studies, anticipate challenges, and ensure regulatory compliance and data integrity at every step.

By integrating advanced analytics, digital tools, and real-world data, we help our partners in Pharma, Biotech, and Medtech demonstrate clinical and real-world value, improving patient outcomes and driving smarter healthcare decisions.

Name: Dreamgenics
Description:
DREAMgenics emerges as a company focused on the design and development of  medical information systems based on the human genome.
This application is essential to facilitate the analysis, management and interpretation of the large amount of data generated by the new genomic technologies. It is aimed mainly at physicians, genetic counselors and other medical personnel to support the decision making when using genomic data as diagnostic method.

Name: Pronacera
Description:
PRONACERA is a biotechnology company focused on developing genetic diagnostic tools and treatments for various medical conditions, including reproductive health, fibromyalgia, and rare or underdiagnosed diseases. Our goal is to optimise healthcare systems by improving both the speed and accuracy of diagnosis. Among our multiple R&D projects, reproductive genomics and functional endometrial molecular biology stand out as key areas of innovation.

At PRONACERA, we are constantly seeking the best ways to provide advanced genetic evaluation services for patients whose quality of life is impacted by diagnostic gaps. We operate through a B2B model, partnering with clinics and medical professionals who deliver our extensive range of products to patients. This makes us a key support system for both specialists and patients in making informed genomic decisions.

Our company’s growth is driven by continuous research and development, empowering scientists while maintaining a personalised and patient-centred approach.

Name: Biovert
Description:
Biovert fue una empresa fundada en 1988 y especializada en bioestimulación y nutrición vegetal.
A lo largo de su trayectoria apostó por la innovación y el desarrollo de tecnologías propias.
En 2024 fue adquirida por Sustainable Agro Solutions (SAS). SAS sigue desarrollando y comercializando las soluciones manvert en los cinco continentes.

Name: LabGenetics. Laboratorio de Genética Clínica
Description:
LabGenetics (Laboratorio de Genética Clínica S.L.) es un centro privado de biotecnología, fundado en Madrid en el año 2004 y ubicado en San Sebastián de los Reyes. El campo de actuación de la compañía se engloba dentro del sector de la Salud Humana. LabGenetics realiza análisis genéticos humanos aplicados tanto al Diagnóstico Genético de enfermedades hereditarias como a la Genética Forense. Actualmente, LabGenetics es centro de referencia, a nivel europeo, en Diagnóstico Genético de enfermedades hereditarias, entre las que se incluyen un gran número de las denominadas "Enfermedades Raras".

Desde marzo de 2020, LabGenetics forma parte de una alianza de laboratorios (www.alianzacovid19.es) que se han unido para poder ofrecer pruebas diagnósticas de infección activa (PDIA) para SARS-CoV-2 asociada a la enfermedad COVID-19, utilizando todo tipo de test diagnósticos (PCR, Antígenos y Anticuerpos).

LabGenetics ha sido el primer centro de la Comunidad de Madrid cuyas Unidades de Genética y Obtención de Muestras han recibido la autorización sanitaria definitiva de apertura y funcionamiento, por parte de la Dirección General de Calidad, Acreditación, Evaluación e Inspección de la CONSEJERÍA DE SANIDAD Y CONSUMO (Licencia Sanitaria no CS13269).

LabGenetics está certificado mediante la norma ISO 9001:2015 con lo que demuestra su capacidad para proporcionar de forma coherente productos o servicios que satisfacen los requisitos del cliente y los reglamentos aplicables.

LabGenetics participa anualmente en los controles de calidad externos organizados por la EMQN (European Molecular Genetics Quality Network) para secuenciación masiva (NGS), secuenciación Sanger, estudio molecular de Ataxias espinocerebelosas, Corea de Huntington, Distrofia Miotónica Tipo1 (Steinert), Distrofia Muscular de Duchenne y Becker y Neuropatías motoras y sensoriales hereditarias, entre otras
Location: San Sebastián de los Reyes, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: DiNA Science
Description:
DiNA Science is a laboratory that provides genetic services to reproductive medicine centers for their patients during IVF procedures.
DiNAScience is our idea that doing things differently is possible, with a vision of commitment to provide a personal, close, serious, innovative and rigorous genetic service, but also dynamic, adaptable and focused on the needs of each person and client.
At DiNAScience we put genetics at the service of people.
DiNA Science has its origins in Reprogenetics Spain and Geniality. In 2000 Santiago Munné and Jacques Cohen, pioneers in Preimplantation Genetic Diagnosis (PGD) founded Reprogenetics and in 2003, together with Carles Giménez, Mireia Sandalinas and Emma Triviño co-founded Reprogenetics Spain. First laboratory specialized in PGD services in Europe. Subsequently, in 2015, Reprogenetics Spain acquires Geniality, a laboratory in Madrid specialized in reproductive genetics. In 2021, the companies change their name to DiNA Science.

DiNA Science es un laboratorio que ofrece servicios de test genéticos a centros de Reproducción Asistida. 
DiNAScience es nuestra idea de que hacer las cosas de otra manera es posible, con una visión de compromiso para proporcionar un servicio genético personal, próximo, serio, innovador y riguroso, pero también dinámico, adaptable y centrado en las necesidades de cada persona y cliente.
En DiNAScience ponemos la genética al servicio de las personas.

DiNA Science tiene sus origenes en Reprogenetics Spain y Geniality. En el año 2000  Santiago Munné y  Jacques Cohen, pioneros en el Diagnóstico Genético Preimplantacional (DGP) fundan Reprogenetics y en el año 2003,  junto con Carles Giménez y Mireia Sandalinas co-fundan Reprogenetics Spain. Primer laboratorio especializado en servicios de DGP de Europa.  En el año 2015, Reprogenetics Spain adquiere Geniality,  laboratorio de Madrid especializado en genética reproductiva. En el año 2021, las compañias cambian de nombre y se convierten en DiNA Science.

Name: Grupo AGROVIN
Description:
Grupo Agrovin is the global and strategic partner of the wineries, with more than 60 years of experience in the wine sector as an advisor technician and supplier of oenological products, systems and machinery, who accompanies oenologists to define the character of their wines in
in line with market trends. It is also a supplier of products and machinery for other sectors such as food, beer and oil, as well as the industrial and pharmaceutical sector, among others.
Founded in 1957 in the heart of La Mancha, the largest wine-growing region in Europe, it is a world reference with headquarters in Italy, Romania, France and the USA, and is present in 20 countries around the world, serving more than 5000 wineries.
Leader in innovation, it has its own R + D + i area and the largest laboratory in Spain made up of a team of highly qualified professionals. Pioneers in biotechnology and in the development of patented solutions and systems that allow facilitate the control of winemaking processes, betting on energy efficiency, digitization and 4.0 technology.
His extensive experience and knowledge of the sector has led him to take part in important innovation projects with the
The most prestigious universities and research centers at an international level, working to improve the enology of the future.
Location: Alcázar de San Juan, Castile-La Mancha, Spain

Name: Condalab
Description:
Founded in 1960, Condalab is Spain's first dehydrated culture media for microbiology and molecular biology manufacturer, as well as one of the world's leading ones. Condalab is also recognized for offering key ingredients such as agars, peptones and agaroses, among other products.

From our Madrid factory, we export to more than 120 countries all over the world, with our own offices and authorized distributors. A great human team that, together with our product, is the fundamental factor for Condalab's international success.

As a result of our leadership in the field of microbiology, we distribute leading brands in the Spanish market, positioning ourselves as one of the main distributors of molecular biology. Our microbiology product catalog is complemented with solutions for molecular biology, offering a global pack.

Our corporate mission is to contribute to progress in the field of life sciences through the design, development and marketing of products for microbiology and molecular biology, managing to establish with our clients, employees, suppliers and shareholders, long-term, trust relationships.

Our 60 years of experience have enabled us to master culture media technology and manufacturing process. 

Quality and continuity are the soul of the brand, our added value as a manufacturer, what we have been doing for more than 60 years: The experience of knowing all the applications, capacities and potentialities of culture media. We are a committed, close and effective team, which is firm in its commitment to remain a model. We are specialized professionals, strengthened by their know-how, motivated and prepared to evolve.

Efficiency is the key to success with our clients. We are decisive, tenacious and detailed. Our self-demand in everything we do makes our products a model. We offer a quality product, and we are recognized for it. 

We know that the difference lies in small details. We guarantee 100% reliability. We offer quality, guarantee and results.
Location: Torrejón de Ardoz, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: Flomics
Description: Flomics is developing novel blood-based diagnostic tools for a broad range of complex diseases. Our proprietary technology accurately identifies pattern changes in the circulating long RNA molecules of patients. With deep learning algorithms we identify RNA changes associated with disease states in a faster, cheaper and non-invasive way.

Name: BioExpert Network
Description:
The BioExpert Network, or BEN, is an exclusive network of experts in the sectors of health, biotechnology, life science and investment.

Members have the opportunity to access and evaluate funding proposals for innovative research and development projects before anyone else, and help shape the future of life science and medicine.

Proposals which receive the most positive evaluations, in terms of innovation, scientific validity, team and business potential have the opportunity to progress to a crowdfunding campaign with Capital Cell,  the first online investment platform in Europe specialized in health and biotechnology.

PhD level scientists, physicians, IP lawyers, life science entrepreneurs, specialist investors and industry consultants with experience in the biotech and healthcare sectors are all encouraged to apply. As an exclusive network, please note that each application is subject to personal evaluation and approval.

Apply to join our growing network at www.bioexpertnetwork.com

Name: IBiS Instituto de Biomedicina de Sevilla
Description:
El Instituto de Biomedicina de Sevilla (IBiS) es un centro multidisciplinar cuyo objetivo es llevar a cabo investigación fundamental sobre las causas y mecanismos de las patologías más prevalentes en la población y el desarrollo de nuevos métodos de diagnóstico y tratamiento para las mismas.

El IBiS lo forman 42 grupos consolidados y 37 grupos adscritos dirigidos por investigadores de la Universidad de Sevilla, el Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC) y los Hospitales Universitarios Virgen del Rocío y Virgen Macarena organizados en torno a cinco áreas temáticas: Enfermedades Infecciosas y del Sistema Inmunitario, Neurociencias, Oncohematología y Genética, Patología Cardiovascular, Respiratoria / Otras Patologías Sistémicas; y Enfermedades Hepáticas, Digestivas e Inflamatorias.

El IBiS depende institucionalmente de la Consejería de Salud y Familias de la Junta de Andalucía; el Servicio Andaluz de Salud (SAS); la Consejería de Transformación Económica, Industria, Conocimiento y Universidades; la Universidad de Sevilla y el CSIC.

Name: GENinCode Predictive Genetics
Description:
GENinCode specializes in risk assessment and prediction of cardiovascular disease , thrombosis and familial hypercholesterolemia . Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is a broad disease classification including coronary artery disease such as angina and myocardial infarction often referred to as heart attack. CVD also includes stroke, heart failure, hypertension and other vascular heart diseases and is the leading cause of death and disability worldwide accounting for 1 in every 4 deaths in the United States.

GENinCode provides advanced genomic technology, products and recommendations fully validated by our scientific and clinical team. 

Our goal is to provide doctors and health care practitioners with advanced health information that combines both traditional clinical measures with a patient’s genetic information to provide a comprehensive risk assessment and clinical recommendation to help decision-making. Our technology helps select the optimal treatment pathway and informs and educates patients to become more aware of their cardiovascular risk helping patient adherence and empowerment to better manage their health.

GENinCode technology and advanced genomic products provide information that helps patients and healthcare practitioners to assess and predict the onset of cardiovascular disease, thrombosis, and the diagnosis of Familial Hypercholesterolemia. Our online reporting system SITAB helps inform doctors of their patients’ health risk enabling patient behavioral and lifestyle changes alongside delivering the most effective therapies and treatment pathways.

Name: SANIFRUIT
Description:
Sanifruit es una empresa biotecnológica innovadora dedicada al desarrollo de soluciones postcosecha naturales y sin residuos fitosanitarios para una fruta más sana y sostenible.

Nacimos con el objetivo de poder ofrecer a los consumidores una fruta libre de residuos fitosanitarios, saludable para las personas y que no impactara de forma negativa en el medio ambiente; Y este es el motor que ha guiado a nuestra empresa durante más de 35 años.

Name: DARWIN Bioprospecting Excellence
Description: DARWIN Bioprospecting Excellence is a microbial biotechnology company specializing in advanced bioprospecting to transform microbial diversity into solutions for industry. DARWIN Bioprospecting Excellence seeks unique strains from diverse origins around the world and converts their potential into revolutionary solutions for the health and nutrition sectors as well as biosolutions. Its mission is clear: to innovate in biodiscovery by empowering the infinitely small.

Name: Agarose Bead Technologies (ABT)
Description:
Agarose Bead Technologies (ABT) is a leading European manufacturer of high-quality agarose resins supporting the biopharmaceutical and bioprocessing industries. 

Agarose resins are manufactured under a rigorous quality management system (QMS) needed to meet the requirements of the bioprocessing industry. These resins are used in variety of process development and commercial-scale cGMP chromatographic purification applications.

Our custom products are made in compliance with client specifications in large scale industry standards. ABT is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company with cGMP facilities operated by experts with in-depth knowledge of agarose.

Our expanding and growing global footprint enable us to offer high-performance chromatography resins to meet the evolving needs of the biopharmaceutical industry.

Name: AMSlab
Description: Our business group is made up of biotechnological companies facilitate Analytical Services. Currently we are present in the pharmaceutical, clinical, veterinary, and food sectors. It also has production plants for standards and kits for these sectors.

Since the foundation of Atens, in 1994, we have assumed the leadership of the industry in terms of knowledge about the use of microorganisms in agriculture.

Name: Integra Therapeutics
Description:
At Integra Therapeutics we have combined the precision of CRISPR systems with the gene transfer efficiency of viral integrases and transposases.

Harnessing what nature has evolved to introduce large pieces of DNA into the genome, together with the precision of sequence specific DNA binding proteins, has allowed for unprecedented efficiency in programmable gene delivery.

Name: Amadix
Description:
AMADIX is a leading molecular diagnostics company focused on liquid biopsy, developing innovative diagnostic tests for early cancer detection in blood.

The mission of the company is extending people's lives, developing disruptive technologies to detect the tumor years in advance, before the symptoms appear.

Name: LipoTrue
Description: Derived from the need to innovate and swiftly adapt in the dynamic and fast-changing cosmetic market, LipoTrueTM has come forward. This company moves a step up into the world of technologies, developing new active ingredients by acting as a central R&D engine integrating high technological platforms. These platforms are: the use of Wild Plants as Biofactories for human synthetic proteins synthesis, in silico and biomimetic design of new peptides, Marine bio-research of new microorganisms, LipoTrue GreenbeatTM and Big Data Analytics. LipoTrueTM manages these platforms for the rapid generation of the next active ingredients. LipoTrueTM is a new project with a solid scientific team of 30 multidisciplinary specialists, with an average cosmetic experience of more than 10 years.

Name: OPERON
Description:
OPERON is a private Spanish company founded as a family business in 1973 engaged during the last 50 years in R&D innovation and manufacturing of In Vitro Diagnostics IVD. Active in the clinical diagnostics, in the  veterinary field and in the food industry checking frauds in milk. The company is ISO 9001:2000  and ISO 13.485:2008 certified complying with cGMP . 

OPERON employs above 80 highly skilled and experienced people, 20 of them involved in R&D work. 
OPERON controls the whole added value chain of a new IVD test. Starting with the design of  the raw materials, producing the kits and selling the IVD test to the end users through distributors or through its partners channels. 

OPERON is active in 4 different areas:

1. Lateral Flow Tests, more than 20 years experience. Working on a 3rd quantitative generation using fluorescent particles and a portable Point Of Care POC reading instrument.

2. Molecular Biology  tests, based on different technologies: hybridization on strip (Opegen products), and Real Time PCR.
All these products are based on the capture with specific probes of DNA fragments amplified by a conventional PCR.

3. Raw Materials: Develops Monoclonal Antibodies and Recombinant Antigens and produces them also in bioreactors and fermentors at industrial scale. 

4. All our know how is available as a service. Development of new Monoclonal Antibodies  and Recombinant Antigens, large scale production, purification. The development of innovative IVD tests is our most challenging task.

Exporting more than 90% of its turnover mainly to Europe, US, Japan and 50 more countries. OPERON currently sells its brand name products using a network of distributors around the world, but our largest activity is to manufacture OEM kits or to supply in bulk to leading companies in the IVD sector.

Name: Mediterranean Algae
Description: Mediterranean Algae was born from the need presented by today's society to find new sustainable production methods that give rise to products with high added value without compromising the future of the planet. Committed to innovation, the study of the properties of algae and their applications in the market, Mediterranean Algae aims to value the native algae of our coasts to generate a great positive impact on society and the environment.

Name: Microomics Systems S.L.
Description:
Microomics Systems, S.L. is a biotech-based spin-off from the Center for Genomic Regulation of the Barcelona Biomedical Research Park (PRBB). 

The company is specialized in metagenomic analyses through the use of new DNA sequencing technologies (NGS). It masters all stages of the analysis process (experimental design, sequencing and bioinformatics) with the aim of characterizing the composition and functions of the microbiome present in a sample.

This service is of interest and utility to various sectors such as Pharmacy, Health, Agriculture and Livestock, Consumer Goods Industry and Environment Industry.

Name: ADmit Therapeutics
Description: ADmit Therapeutics is a biotech company focused on the commercialization of the MAP-AD Test, an AI-powered prognostic test for Alzheimer’s disease with CE-IVDR certification. The company operates a CAP-accredited, CLIA-certified laboratory to offer the MAP-AD Test as an LDT in the US
