Name: Tomsa Destil, S.L.
Description:
TOMSA DESTIL is a Spanish company specialized in the distillation of alcohol and its derivatives in the international market.

We offer our customers the best State of the Art technology for the production of fuel or edible ethanol.

We have supplied over 400 Alcohol Plants, Biodiesel and Bioethanol Plants during the last 30 years on five continents through our established business network in key countries and through our office in Madrid

Name: Ecoculture Biosciences
Description:
At Ecoculture Biosciences, we are working to develop specific solutions to the negative effects of plant stress processes, to improve food quality, to increase yield and to reduce unnecessary wastage. 

eCoCulture is committed to the ideals of sustainable farming, by maximising the productive yield from crops whilst minimising artificial inputs; ensuring the majority of the crop is grown to standards that customers demand and to ensure that the produce is in the best possible condition to pass through the food chain without being wasted. 

EcoCulture has a portfolio focused in the development of specific products to combat the effects of abiotic stress. We formulate our products under the highest quality standards to ensure the best performance at field level.

More info at ecoculturebs.com

Name: Bionure
Description:
Bionure is a clinical-stage biotech company developing therapies for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases for which no treatment options are nowadays available.  Bionure has outsourced the development of part of its portfolio to an investee company and is managing the rest of its portfolio internally.
Our lead candidate BN201 is a small molecule, new chemical entity, first-in-class drug that has been shown to promote neuroprotection and remyelination in several animal models of damage. BN201 has been granted orphan designation for acute optic neuritis in Europe and the US and has been licensed to Oculis.  The product is now in clinical Phase 2 in France. 
With patients in mind, we have built an extraordinary, committed team of experts in neuro-ophthalmology and neuro-inflammation, passionate about bringing meaningful therapies to society with the aim of changing the life of thousands of people.

Name: Nostoc Biotech
Description:
Nostoc Biotech develops, manufactures and field-validates microbiological solutions for professional agriculture: biofertilizers, biostimulants and beneficial microorganisms. We were the first company in Spain to register microorganisms as fertilizers.

WHAT WE SOLVE
Depleted, saline or low-organic-matter soils; crops that need more nutrient efficiency and fewer chemical inputs; growers who want results they can measure, not promises.

OUR TECHNOLOGY
- SIMBIUS (BIO NPK), based on Bacillus altitudinis: phosphorus-solubilising bacteria that unlock nutrients already present in the soil.
- GREENFOL and our foliar range for targeted nutrition at key crop stages.
- Liquid and solid earthworm humus, plus the BLACK, WHITE, RED, RUBY, GRANITE, EBONY, LOTO and NAVY lines for soil health, root development and tolerance to water and saline stress.

EVIDENCE, NOT CLAIMS
Every product goes through field trials with control plots and published data, run by our own technical team and with research partners. Growers can see yield, quality and cost figures before they commit.

CROPS
Vegetables under plastic and outdoors, citrus, olive, vine, stone and tropical fruit, nuts, strawberries and berries, melon and watermelon, cereals, maize, rice, cotton, legumes, garlic and onion, tobacco and turf.

WHERE WE ARE
Headquarters and production in Roquetas de Mar (Almeria), with field technicians covering Andalusia, Murcia, the Valencian Community, Castilla-La Mancha, Extremadura, Galicia and the Ebro valley (Zaragoza, Lleida and Tarragona).

Want to know if it works on your crop? Send us a direct message or visit nostoc.es

Name: Mendel Brain
Description:
LOVE WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE
Investigamos la genética del comportamiento para ayudar
a promover la salud mental y el bienestar emocional.

Mendel Brain es una empresa pionera en la investigación de la genética aplicada a la psicología humana que se centra en el estudio e interpretación de la genética de la personalidad, la conducta y la salud mental de las personas.

¿Cómo podemos ayudarte?
Salud mental para empresas: Ayudamos a las empresas a desarrollar planes de actuación en el área del bienestar emocional, adaptados a las necesidades reales de los empleados.

Contribuimos al diseño de planes de intervención que disminuyan la probabilidad de que un trabajador sufra episodios de ansiedad causados por el estrés.

Investigación: Colaboramos con grupos de investigación para avanzar en el desarrollo de la ciencia que estudia la conexión entre variantes genéticas y enfermedades mentales en distintas áreas.

Name: LEGIPID Legionella Fast Detection
Description:
Biótica is the first biotechnological company located at Science and Technology Park of Jaume I University, since 2009, focused on the development of fast microbial detection techniques combining immunomagnetic capture and enzyme immunoassay (C.E.I.A.). Description:

Name: Centro de Biotecnología y Genómica de Plantas
Description:
La Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM) aprueba la creación de un Centro de Biotecnología y Genómica de Plantas en octubre de 2005, a propuesta de un grupo de profesores del Departamento de Biotecnología. Se trata de una iniciativa que se venía madurando desde hacía tiempo de forma conjunta con investigadores del Instituto Nacional de Investigación y Tecnología Agraria y Alimentaria (INIA). Finalmente el CBGP se constituye como un Centro Mixto de Investigación tras la firma del acuerdo bilateral UPM – INIA en Julio de 2006

El CBGP se crea con la doble finalidad de contribuir al desarrollo sostenible de los sectores agrícola, forestal y medioambiental a través de la Bio-Economía Basada en el Conocimiento (KBBE), y de aumentar la competitividad de la investigación y producción en estas áreas. Además desempeña un papel educativo y persigue el convertirse en un centro de referencia en la formación de científicos y técnicos en el campo de la biotecnología y la genómica de plantas, un área cuyo desarrollo tiene aún mucho recorrido por delante en España.
Location: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain

Name: TRADICHEM GROUP
Description:
TRADICHEM GROUP is a world leader in the development, marketing, and manufacturing of nutraceuticals and APIs.

TRADICHEM has been developing high-quality ingredients for the betterment of people's lives since 1993. Our company has evolved technologically since 2008, becoming an integral company with two R&D centers, four manufacturing sites, and three offices in the US and the EU. Name: ALLOX
Description: ALLOX is a spin-off of the Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) and draws on the expertise and technology developed in the lab of Ben Lehner. The company was born out of the realisation that combining systematic mutagenesis, high-throughput phenotyping and biophysical modelling has the potential to revolutionise drug development but also transform biotechnology in general. We are currently incubating in the beautiful beachfront setting of the Barcelona Biomedical Research Park (PRBB), and our immediate goal is to identify allosteric switches in all proteins and then leverage this unprecedented resource to rapidly develop novel medicines to treat human diseases. Our long-term vision is to become a leader in programmable biology, building the next generation of tools to predict, design and engineer new protein functions.

Name: Enzymlogic
Description:
Enzymlogic is a world leader in the kinetic profiling of compounds to facilitate drug discovery. As experts in the generation and interpretation of kinetic data, we pride ourselves on a proven track record of successful partnerships with worldwide organizations of all sizes, supporting them on a routine basis during the early phases of drug discovery.

We use exquisitely tuned assays to deliver accurate, robust and reproducible kinetic data of the highest quality that enhances the identification of compounds with the greatest therapeutic potential.

The insight we provide facilitates the screening of compounds at speed and at scale to iterate medicinal chemistry, understand pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD) disconnects and build better models to define therapeutic windows. 

You can email at info@enzymlogic.com to request further information on Enzymlogic’s drug discovery services and partnering information.

Name: mjn-neuro
Description:
mjn-neuro is a company dedicated to the design, manufacture and commercialization of medical devices with the aim of improving people's quality of life. All this activity is accompanied by an important policy of reinvestment of resources in R&I and social action.

The first device that mjn-neuro is developing is mjn-SERAS: an earpiece that assesses the risk of epileptic seizures. Description:
Origen Corporación tiene como objetivo mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas aplicando la tecnológica presente y futura. Name: HAWK Biosystems
Description:
HAWK Biosystems is a biotechnology company spun out of the Francis Crick Institute in London. HAWK has developed a breakthrough tissue analysis technology for the precise quantitative analysis of protein function in tissue. With an extraordinary dynamic range, HAWK’s QF-Pro technology is the only solution capable of delivering reliable, reproducible, and unbiased quantitative cut-off values linked to protein functional states in situ.

By enabling direct measurement of true protein activity rather than expression or proximity alone, the technology opens new avenues for precision medicine, translational research, and companion diagnostics. It has demonstrated strong, evidence-based clinical outcomes, with published data showing significant potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and patient stratification in immuno-oncology and other therapeutic indications.

Name: Gold Standard Diagnostics Madrid

Gold Standard Diagnostics Madrid

Name: PERSEO Biotechnology S.L.
Description:
PERSEO Biotechnology S.L. specializes in developing industrial processes to valorize the organic and cellulosic fractions of waste and by-products into high-value biobased products, such as advanced bioethanol, bioproducts, and bioenergy. This is achieved through proprietary technology and in-house expertise. With over 17 years of experience in scaling projects, since 2020 we also count REPSOL among our shareholders to further drive valorization projects.

Our technology is rooted in industrial circular economy principles, developing sustainable projects aimed at decarbonizing industrial processes and reducing the carbon footprint.

We have participated in and developed over 20 innovation projects and are currently focused on applied developments for waste valorization in the agri-food industry. For this, we rely on our own laboratories and a semi-industrial facility located in L'Alcudia, Valencia.

Name: NIMBLE Diagnostics
Description:
Stents are one of the most implanted devices in the world, and are used to restore the correct flow of blood or other fluids. 
They are especially useful to prevent heart attacks or to treat its lasting symptoms, but once implanted can become blocked or damaged, which occur in almost a third of the cases. This progression occurs gradually, but symptoms appear only after the stent is already 90% occluded, which is too late to prevent worsening conditions. 
Then, in most cases, clinicians need to perform an invasive procedure called angiography, which consists in inserting a catheter into the artery to directly inspect the stent. Obviously, this is a very complex and invasive procedure, where the patient needs anesthesia, lots of X-ray exposure and a 24h hospitalization recovery. Moreover, this is very expensive, as you need highly trained staff, bedding care and expensive reagents. All of this leads to a situation where clinicians cannot act upon the problem until it has already manifested, which increases the incidence of serious complications, including strokes, heart attacks or sudden death, which could be otherwise preventable. 

In order to change this situation, we are developing a microwave-based technology that can read the electromagnetic signature of the stent non-invasively. Our main objective is to be able to measure and monitor any issue with in-stent restenosis, thrombosis or stent fractures. All of these characteristics translate into a product, the NIMBLE system, which will enable early treatments to prevent negative outcomes. Medication compliance c ouldbe identified and managed, symptoms could be correlated with stent function, and triggers of cardiac events could be found before it is too late. We are developing micro-wave based technologies to monitor the functional integrity of stents.

First Project: New anti-metastatic drug

Since cancer is the second cause of death worlwide, there is an urgent need for more effective and personalized treatments of tumors.

Metastasis development is the main cause of patient death in most tumor types but the control of metastasis in cancer is still an unmet medical need. The current surgery-based approaches and conventional chemotherapy can be enhanced using new technologies.

Our first project is a self-assembling protein nanoparticle that selectively kills metastatic cells. This nanoconjugate targets CXCR4 receptors which are over-expressed in metastatic cells of many types of cáncer.

Preclinical results look very promising: in vivo results show that our drug-loaded nanoconjugate accumulates in primary tumor and metastatic foci with negible presence in liver, kidney, brain or other organs. The result is a significant decrease of the number of metastatic foci and very low toxicity on normal cells.

Our focus now is to complete preclinical development in order to obtain approval for first-in-human trial.

What makes Sandwalk special is its team’s profound understanding of the science and extensive industry experience. This enables us to go beyond advisory and add value by actively engaging with our partners in the execution of their projects. 

The "sandwalk" is the path behind Charles Darwin’s Down House near Kent in the UK, where he lived with his family from 1842 until his death in 1882. Down House provided Darwin with the peace and privacy he needed to mature his theories of evolution and natural selection, run his numerous experiments and write most of his works, including his most celebrated On the Origin of Species. The sandwalk was Darwin’s thinking path, around which he made regular circuits several times a day to think about science.

"Sandwalk" therefore perfectly captures our essence and way of working: a systematic methodology, based on the thorough assessment of the science, to bring disruptive innovations to life.

VIVA-ELISA is the first product developed from this platform. It measures functional NLRP3 inflammasome activation through ASC speck detection, providing a functional readout of this pathway rather than measuring infection or downstream inflammation alone.

Sepsis is our first clinical application because it is urgent, costly and clinically unresolved. It is also a major stratification challenge. VIVA-ELISA is being developed and clinically validated to support the earlier identification of septic patients at higher risk of deterioration, secondary infections and mortality, and to contribute to prognosis and more personalised clinical decisions.

Beyond sepsis, we are exploring applications in other inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases and in pharmaceutical and biotech programmes focused on NLRP3, inflammasomes and immunomodulation.

Our project has been selected by the European Commission through the Horizon Europe EIC Transition programme, with €2.5 million in non-dilutive funding.

VIVA-ELISA has also been recognised by the European Commission’s Innovation Radar as Market Ready, with Very High Market Creation Potential, with Viva in Vitro Diagnostics identified as the Key Innovator. This recognition does not constitute regulatory or clinical approval.

Our goal is to connect science, clinical validation and market development to generate value for patients, clinicians, research organisations, pharmaceutical companies and healthcare systems.

Name: TAONas-LUAD
Description:
TAONas-LUAD stands for: Therapeutic Antisense Oligonucleotides Targeting NUMB Alternative Splicing in Lung Adenocarcinoma. Here at the TAONas consortium, we are dedicated to providing new and more effective treatments for lung cancer patients with a specific subtype known as lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD).
The objectives of our project are to advance our flagship antisense oligonucleotide (AON) therapy towards the clinic by optimizing its composition and formulation and then testing its safety and efficacy in animals. This way, we hope to prepare it for human trials sometime in 2027. At the same time, we are preparing to spin off a company that will make sure that the treatment has the best chance possible to eventually benefit patients.
The TAONas LUAD consortium is led by the Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) of Biomedical Research Park of Barcelona (PRBB). They are supported by IRCM-INSERM (Cancer Research Institute of Montpellier, l'Institut national de la santé et de la recherche médicale), SINTEF (Stiftelsen for industriell og teknisk forskning) and Inveniam Group. The CRG, in addition to leading the consortium, is in charge of commericalization activities, supported by their Technology and Business Development Office as well as Inveniam. They perform many of the important in vivo experiments of the project and direct the design of the antisense oligonucleotide (AON) technology. INSERM provide their expertise in lung orthotopic xenograft models of LUAD, and SINTEF is concerned with the encapsulation of the AONs in lipid nanoparticles. Together the consortium hopes to produce a novel LUAD AON therapy that modulates RNA splicing.
We expect our therapy to be safe and effective, increasing progression-free survival of patients with LUAD and saving money for health systems. We also hope to establish a company that will continue to exploit splice-modulating AON technology for the benefit of patients with a variety of other cancers in the future.

Name: Neural Omega
Description:
Neural Omega is a biotechnology company decoding autoimmunity through molecular mimicry.

The structural resemblance between human and pathogen proteins is increasingly recognised as a driver of autoimmune disease. We have built our work around this principle from end to end: from analysing these patterns at proteome scale to elucidate how autoimmunity arises, to harnessing the same principle in the design of novel therapeutic approaches.

Our work spans two interconnected domains. Neural Omega Research advances in silico discovery and protein science through proprietary systems that categorise molecular-mimicry patterns at proteome scale. Neural Omega Health translates this science into tools that improve the daily lives of clinicians and of the millions of people living with autoimmune conditions worldwide.

Decoding autoimmunity.

These facilities have been designed and conditioned according to cGMP guidelines in order to develop biotherapeutics production processes readily transferable to cGMP production. Process development is further supported by a stringent Quality system that ensures complete, comprehensive and compliant documentation of the process.

Besides providing process development services under request, DRO develops proprietary processes with special emphasis to critical issues in the biopharmaceuticals industry such as productivity, biological activity, purity and absence of antibiotics in the production process.

Technologies developed by DRO are intentionally conceived to enhance bioprocesses productivity and enable industry and research groups to advance in the development of biotherapy, tackling key issues such as therapeutic cells production.

Static Support Bed is a proprietary technology for bioprocesses and therapeutic adherent cells culture highly efficient in contained devices. This technology is based on the substitution of traditional supports with microwires that increase culture surface per volume unit.

Name: Synthetic Biology and Biosystems Control Lab
Description:
We focus our research on the application of systems engineering and control for synthetic biology and bio-systems, as well as the evaluation and control of bio-processes.

At the laboratory, we work on designing prototypes and the proofs of concept for our developments, ranging from genetic circuits for the regulation of metabolic routes to control algorithms and the evaluation of bioreactors.

Combining computing and experimental capacities, we use the DBTL (design, build, test and learn) circuit of bio-engineering, thanks to our vast experience in the modeling and simulation of biological processes, always taking into account the different participating scales: from biological (genetic) parts, to biological devices, strains and microorganisms and their metabolism, as well as the experimental conditions of bio-processes.

In addition, automated build and test strains come from robotic platforms and the experimental results give feedback to the design phase, using artificial intelligence, machine learning and optimization. Thus, we can learn from these experimental data and improve the model predictions and the factor-response relation in the design.

This totally automated workflow meets all the flexibility requirements for an agile design and thus it is expected to be widely adopted in future biology production systems.

Name: Labsinlove
Description:
Labsinlove was founded to generate new molecules and nanoparticles that contribute to the development of advanced cancer therapies and treatments for other diseases, with the ultimate goal of improving people's lives by improving their health.

Specifically, Labsinlove aims to be "the company that is willing to help in whatever is necessary" for the Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT) community, leveraging the scientific foundations and research staff of various research centers.

Our vision:

We believe that BNCT (Boron Neutron Capture Therapy) will provide a solution for multiple types of cancer that are currently difficult to treat with existing therapies. To develop new applications, three parallel advancements need to take place, evolving in a progressively accelerated manner:

Construction of Optimized Neutron Beam Facilities: Building technically and economically optimized neutron beam generating facilities, suitable for carrying out approved treatments and researching new therapies.

Development of High-Selectivity Molecules or Nanoparticles: Creating high-selectivity molecules or nanoparticles targeted at the cells to be destroyed, and scaling up their production to an industrial level.

Conducting Clinical Trials: Implementing trials in various phases aimed at multiple types of cancers and other diseases, until treatments receive approval from health authorities.

In this context, Labsinlove aims to facilitate the development of new molecules and nanoparticles by coordinating efforts from enthusiastic and motivated research laboratories, providing the necessary bridges to bring these innovations to the market

Name: Instant BioSensing Technologies, Inc.
Description:
IBT is created by a few scientists, engineers and senior managers that work together to develop an original solution, in the midst of the Coronavirus (Covid-19) pandemic, to deploy a fast and massive test solution.

That solution, based on a non-invasive spectroscopic and AI approach, will allow a family of products, that will produce instantaneous test results (infected/not infected), from a large-scale industrial test system for large volume sequential testing at places like airports and stadiums, all the way to the development of a personal size device, connected to a smartphone at a price below the present cost of a single test.

The identification of Asymptomatic cases, along with the ability to confirm that some individuals, in the early stage of the infection are actually infected, will allow the quick isolation of those cases away from the rest of the population, dramatically slowing the spread of the infection.

Mission

To provide, to all levels of society and in all countries of the world, a fast and effective Covid-19 test solution, as soon as possible.  That development will then allow us to expand this technology to detect Covid-19 generated antibodies and other disease tests, such as cancer and others. Ultimately, IBT’s objective is to contribute to and lead the medical spectroscopic detection market worldwide.

Name: Instituto de Bioquímica Vegetal y Fotosíntesis
Description: El Instituto de Bioquímica Vegetal y Fotosíntesis (IBVF) es un Centro Mixto de la Universidad de Sevilla (US) y el Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC). El IBVF está especializado en el estudio de la biología fototrófica en sentido amplio, con la particularidad de desarrollar investigaciones con todo tipo de organismos fotosintéticos oxigénicos: cianobacterias, algas y plantas. La fotosíntesis, el proceso que utiliza la energía luminosa y el agua para la producción primaria de materia orgánica y oxígeno, es esencial para la vida en la Tierra. La investigación del IBVF conecta con sectores empresariales relacionados con la agroalimentación, concretamente con el uso de microorganismos fotosintéticos como biofertilizantes y la bioestimulación del crecimiento vegetal, así como el uso de microalgas en procesos de secuestro de gases de efecto invernadero de la atmósfera y como biofactorías para la producción de compuestos de interés industrial. La creciente preocupación social por los efectos adversos del calentamiento global, causado principalmente por la acumulación de gases de efecto invernadero como el CO2, aumenta la utilidad social de la investigación en biología fototrófica que se lleva a cabo en el IBVF.

La CECT lidera la Red Española de Microorganismos “REDESMI” y la participación de España en “MIRRI”, Infraestructura de investigación incluida en las hojas de ruta de ESFRI 2016 española y europea. Name: NET4FLOW
Description:
NET4FLOW Advanced Processes focuses on the development and application of highly optimized enzymatic and other catalytic cutting-edge technologies for the efficient and sustainable production of chemicals using continuous-flow reactors. These advanced processes aim to improve productivity, with reduced waste generation and lower energy demand, by integrating new (chemo)biocatalysts with flow systems and innovative process engineering.
This integrated approach seeks to reduce the environmental impact of chemical production, making it greener and more resource-efficient, in line with the objectives proposed by the European Green Deal, UN Sustainable Development Goals, and broader sustainability objectives in industry. By combining next-generation catalysts, advanced reactor technologies, and flow-based production, the aim is to create high-performance, low-waste, and energy-efficient chemical synthetic processes.
Achieving industrial-scale solutions requires interdisciplinary and intersectoral collaboration across fields. Thus, enzyme technology, catalysis, flow chemistry, and process engineering are hot areas that may be engaged in solving sustainability issues for the transition to a climate-neutral world. This joint effort between European and Latin American research institutions will pave the way for new and strong alliances to optimize enzyme-based processes and catalysts as well as for transitioning innovative technologies into sustainable, large-scale industrial applications. By leveraging the diverse expertise of this project consortium, formed by enzyme engineers and technologists, chemists, flow chemistry specialists, as well as industry partners, the research will bridge the gap between academic discovery and real-world solutions, fostering the adoption of greener, more efficient manufacturing processes.

Name: Luminara Therapeutics
Description:
Luminara Therapeutics is a Madrid-based biotech building the first broad, non-invasive therapy for Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP) — the most common cause of hereditary blindness in working-age adults.
The problem we're solving
2 million people worldwide live with RP. Less than 1% have access to any approved disease-modifying treatment. The only approved therapy (Luxturna) requires a specific genetic mutation and invasive subretinal surgery costing over €1M. The vast majority of patients are left with no options.
Our solution: P1614
P1614 is a first-in-class synthetic peptide (sPIF) delivered as a topical eye drop. It works through an immunomodulatory and neuroprotective mechanism that acts downstream of the primary mutation — making it effective regardless of a patient's genetic profile.
 Mutation-agnostic — works across all RP genotypes
 Topical eye-drop delivery — no injections, no surgery
 Preclinical proof-of-concept in two canonical RP models (rd10 and P23H)
 Human safety already established for sPIF in Phase I/II trials
 Combinable with gene therapies and other modalities
 Pediatric-expandable — addressing the 30–50% diagnosed before age 18
Our strategy
Science-led. Execution-driven. Built for partnering.
We are advancing P1614 toward a first-in-human Phase Ib/IIa trial, targeting Orphan Drug Designation by Q1 2027 and clinic entry in 2028. Our model is asset-first: de-risk → prove in humans → out-license to a major ophthalmology partner.
The team
Founded by world-class retinal neurodegeneration scientists from the CSIC (Spanish National Research Council) CIB 3D Lab, with protected IP anchored by patent family WO 2023/180454.
Life fully open.

Description:
OPL Clínica es una empresa dedicada a la salud y el bienestar a través de terapia por vía intravenosa utilizando OPL (Oxígeno Poliatómico Líquido)
Después de 17 años trabajando con moléculas de oxígeno, el fundador de la Compañía, el catedrático italiano Giovanni Barco y su equipo, lograron descubrir propiedades excepcionales del OPL. Desarrollaron métodos de tratamiento para una larga lista de enfermedades, patologías y dolencias y crearon una tecnología revolucionaria para fabricar equipos capaces de garantizar una dosificación personalizada y segura de medicamentos para cada paciente. Durante este tiempo dicha terapia ha sido utilizada por más de 25.000 personas en Europa. Hoy en día tenemos la posibilidad de poner a disposición de los pacientes la cuarta generación de equipos, garantizando tratamientos no sólo seguros, sino también prácticamente indoloros y reduciendo la duración de los mismos de 60 minutos en los equipos de primera generación a 5-10 minutos actualmente. Name: BackupME

Its core objective is the development of structured systems capable of modeling, organizing and preserving post-biographical cognitive patterns through advanced semantic mapping and digital continuity frameworks.

The Institute focuses on the transformation of fragmented human data — writings, voice patterns, conceptual structures, decision pathways and semantic correlations — into coherent cognitive architectures. These architectures are designed as structured identity continuums grounded in documented intellectual production and verified informational matrices.

Currently led by its founder Mario J. Pezzi, holder of registered intellectual property and proprietary methodologies, BackupME Institute is in its foundational research and prototyping phase. The project integrates large-scale knowledge vault structuring, semantic interconnection modeling and synthetic voice alignment to explore the boundaries between memory, cognition and digital persistence.

The long-term vision is to establish a rigorous technological and epistemological framework for cognitive continuity systems, opening collaboration to neuroscientists, AI engineers, software developers, data scientists and legal experts interested in pioneering research on identity persistence.

BackupME Institute aims to construct structured cognitive mirrors based on documented semantic topology and information coherence.

Trazabilidad Real: Gestionamos nuestra propia cadena de suministro en Chile, trabajando codo a codo con recolectores locales. Esto nos permite garantizar un origen ético y orgánico que muchas comercializadoras desconocen.

Facilitación Normativa: Entendemos las barreras de entrada en diferentes mercados, por esto, entregamos toda la documentación técnica (CoA, MSDS, TDS) para hacer expeditas las pruebas y validaciones.

Nuestra meta es ser un socio de confianza para laboratorios que desarrollen soluciones de longevidad y nutricosmética premium. Calidad, ciencia y salud.
